notes.renekton-skill-q: Q heals more as it hits more targets. Empowered Q increases both damage and healing. Use Q where there are targets to hit so it can heal you.
notes.renekton-skill-w: W cancels the basic attack animation and activates immediately. W has slightly more range than a basic attack. Against an opponent walking away, use W immediately after a basic attack. Use W immediately after Flash to attempt a surprise stun. Empowered W destroys the target's shield before its third hit.
notes.renekton-skill-e: If the first E dash misses all units, you cannot use the second dash. Before engaging, choose a minion or opponent to hit with the first E so you have a way out. Empowered E's armor reduction applies only to the second cast. Give empowered E low priority unless an allied physical damage dealer will keep attacking the same target.
notes.renekton-phase: Renekton poses little threat at levels 1–2, when he lacks abilities. Renekton poses a strong threat at level 3, when he has his basic abilities, and level 6, when he gains R. Renekton is strong in lane and objective fights through the mid game, when core items come in. Renekton's lack of sustained damage and long cooldowns leave him weak in extended fights after his combo. Renekton's value drops sharply in the late game. Turn an early lead into objectives and lane pressure.
notes.renekton-situational-armor: If the opponent's physical damage is strong, buy Plated Steelcaps early. If you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first to survive lane. If the enemy has multiple physical damage dealers, buy Randuin's Omen for armor and health.
notes.renekton-situational-antiheal: If the opponent's healing turns trades in their favor, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Renekton loses his advantage against opponents who heal back the damage from his short combo.
notes.renekton-laning: In lane, keep your Fury near half full. Manage Fury with last hits and Q farming without pushing the lane far enough to expose yourself to a gank. Engage right after your opponent uses a poke ability. After using W and E, avoid aggressive positioning until both abilities are off cooldown.
notes.renekton-teamfight: In teamfights, land empowered W on a key enemy damage dealer, then disengage with E. Before entering a teamfight, secure a target for E so you can disengage. Decide when to use R before entering a teamfight. If the enemy frontline is sturdy, attack the backline from the side.
notes.vs-renekton-fury: Check Renekton's Fury bar to judge how threatening he is. If his Fury is over half full, stay out of range to avoid empowered W's long stun. Stay alert even if his Fury is just under half full: one basic attack or Q may make an empowered ability available. Force a trade when his Fury is empty and his damage is reduced.
notes.vs-renekton-deny-fury: Poke him consistently to prevent fights and limit his Fury generation. Renekton's Fury decreases while he is out of combat. Poke Renekton when he steps up to hit minions for Fury.
notes.vs-renekton-post-combo: Renekton is vulnerable after his first combo because he lacks sustained damage and has long cooldowns. Survive the first combo, then counterattack while Q, W, and E are all on cooldown. Focus on Renekton immediately after he uses E to disengage.
notes.vs-renekton-e: Renekton's E allows a second dash only if the first dash hits a unit. Avoid standing in or behind your minion wave so allied minions cannot serve as Renekton's way in. After taking his combo, retreat in a direction where Renekton has no target to hit with E.
notes.vs-renekton-shield: Empowered W destroys the target's shield. If Renekton’s Fury is full, avoid trying to absorb his combo with a shield. Use shields for sustain after taking Renekton's combo and backing away.
notes.vs-renekton-scaling: Renekton becomes much more threatening at levels 3 and 6. While R is active and granting bonus health and Fury, avoid fighting him one-on-one and wait for it to end. Farm without giving Renekton kills until his value drops after the mid game.
notes.rengar-skill-passive-ferocity: Using any ability except Rengar's ultimate builds Ferocity. At maximum Ferocity, his next ability is empowered. Using an empowered ability briefly increases his movement speed. Rengar's damage depends heavily on using Ferocity on empowered Q, W, and E at the right times. Each enemy champion kill adds a trophy to his necklace and permanently increases his attack damage. Prioritize a guaranteed kill over other gains.
notes.rengar-skill-passive-leap: Leaping from brush with no Ferocity grants one stack.
notes.rengar-skill-q: Q empowers the next basic attack and increases attack speed. Use Q right after a basic attack to fill the gap between attacks. At maximum Ferocity, Q deals much more damage and grants much more attack speed. Use maximum-Ferocity Q when you can reliably stay on the target.
notes.rengar-skill-w: W heals some of the damage taken recently. Use W right after taking heavy damage to heal more. Maximum-Ferocity W removes crowd control. Save Ferocity for W if the enemy still has an immobilizing ability. W deals bonus damage to jungle monsters and heals a large portion of the damage taken.
notes.rengar-skill-e: E briefly reveals the location of the first enemy it hits. If you lose sight of an enemy during a chase, throw E along their expected path to locate them. Use E to find enemies hiding in brush. Maximum-Ferocity E roots instead of slowing. Spend Ferocity on E when you need to root an enemy without a mobility ability.
notes.rengar-skill-r-scout: After activating R, there is a brief delay before Rengar becomes camouflaged. R grants vision around the nearest enemy champion. Use R's vision to locate your target before approaching. R's camouflage ends when Rengar enters the enemy's detection range. When approaching with R, take a wide route around the side or behind the enemy.
notes.rengar-combo-burst: Use W in a combo right after the enemy retaliates.
notes.rengar-combo-choose: Use empowered E to root enemies who can escape. If an enemy you have already reached can retaliate with an immobilizing ability, remove it with empowered W. If the enemy has no way to escape or retaliate, maximize damage with empowered Q. Choose your empowered ability before engaging.
notes.rengar-laning-clear: Focus on W when clearing the jungle. Rengar's resource is not mana, so mana costs do not limit him. Use W to maintain health while clearing camps in succession and ganking often.
notes.rengar-laning-gank: Engaging with E first from an angle without brush gives the enemy time to react before you reach them.
notes.rengar-phase: Rengar is strongest in the mid game, when he has R and his first core item. In the mid game, pick off enemies in the backline. In the late game, enemy vision and defensive items make it harder to engage. Use the lead built in the mid game to finish the game.
notes.rengar-teamfight: In teamfights, kill enemies in the backline. Use R's vision to find your target, then circle around to engage from the side or behind. Engage after the enemy uses their immobilizing abilities on your frontline. Before engaging, plan an escape route for after your burst damage.
notes.rengar-situational-antiheal: If enemy healing is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Rengar deals damage in a short burst, so healing just before a kill can easily turn the outcome.
notes.vs-rengar-ferocity: When Rengar's resource bar is full, his next ability is empowered. Trade with Rengar when his resource bar is empty.
notes.vs-rengar-r: Do not travel alone while injured. Stay close to allies so your detection ranges overlap and can reveal Rengar before he leaps.
notes.vs-rengar-w: Use immobilizing abilities and burst damage right after Rengar uses W.
notes.vs-rengar-e: Use mobility abilities after Rengar misses E. If Rengar's E hits you, hiding in brush still reveals your location to him.
notes.vs-rengar-punish: E is Rengar's only way to immobilize enemies. Counter Rengar's engage, then hold him in place with an immobilizing ability.
notes.riven-combo-basic: Use this basic trade combo: Q1 → basic attack → Q2 → basic attack → W → basic attack → Q3. Weave a basic attack between each Q to secure damage. Using Q casts back to back leaves no time for basic attacks and reduces your damage.
notes.riven-combo-cancel: Use Q before the basic attack animation ends to cancel its recovery. Cancel Q's recovery with a basic attack, E, or W. If animation cancels are unfamiliar, focus on landing one basic attack.
notes.riven-combo-burst: Use this kill combo: E → Q1 → basic attack → W → basic attack → Q2 → basic attack → Q3 → activate R → recast R. Activate R while the target is airborne from Q3. Wind Slash deals more damage the more health the target has lost. Use Wind Slash at the end of the combo.
notes.riven-skill-q-cursor: If your cursor is over a champion when you cast Q, the dash direction locks toward that champion. To dash past an opponent with Q, place your cursor beyond them. Casting Q with your cursor over the opponent stops you in front of them.
notes.riven-skill-q-terrain: Only the third Q cast can cross terrain. The third Q cast knocks enemies back. To escape or chase over a wall, use Q twice beforehand to prepare the third cast. Using all three Q casts in a trade removes your escape route over a wall.
notes.riven-skill-passive: Using an ability grants a passive stack. Basic attacks consume passive stacks. Using only abilities without basic attacks wastes passive stacks beyond the cap. Even while clearing a wave, leave yourself a chance to use passive stacks on the opposing champion.
notes.riven-skill-w: W stuns in a very short area around Riven. Get close with Q or E before using W. W interrupts an opponent's channeled ultimate. Save W if the opponent is in a position to use a channeled ability.
notes.riven-skill-e: E grants a shield as Riven dashes. E's shield scales with bonus attack damage. E cannot cross terrain. Before engaging with E, check whether Q3 will be available to disengage.
notes.riven-skill-r: Activating R increases attack damage. Activating R increases the range of basic attacks and abilities. Wind Slash can be used only once while R is active. Unless it will secure the finish, save Wind Slash and keep fighting with R's bonus attack damage.
notes.riven-laning: Riven uses no resources, so she can trade whenever her abilities come off cooldown. Riven is most vulnerable just after using all her Q casts to clear minions. When pushing a wave, save at least one Q cast to respond to a counterattack.
notes.riven-phase: Riven is weak at levels 1–2. Once Riven has Q, W, and E at level 3, she can look for a kill with a full combo. Riven hits her first power spike when she learns R at level 6. Riven is strongest in the mid game as she builds ability haste and attack damage. In the late game, choose your engage carefully because it is hard to break through a tanky frontline alone.
notes.riven-teamfight: In teamfights, avoid engaging the enemy frontline head-on. Engage the enemy backline from the side or out of vision with E and Q3. Before engaging, check whether you will have a Q cast left to disengage. Riven has no self-healing. If there is no opening to engage in a teamfight, pressure a side lane.
notes.riven-teamfight-multi-melee: Riven is strong in scrappy fights against multiple melee champions at once. Q3 and W can hit multiple opponents at once. Riven struggles when a ranged damage dealer attacks while keeping a safe distance. If you cannot reach the ranged damage dealer, wait for another chance to engage.
notes.riven-situational-antiheal: If the opponent sustains through healing, buy Executioner's Calling early to finish them after your combo. Riven relies on burst damage concentrated in a short window.
notes.vs-riven-mobility: Riven can cover a long distance by chaining three Q dashes and one E dash. If you have pushed too far beyond vision, check whether all of Riven's dash abilities are available. Each of Riven's dashes travels a short distance. When you see Riven's first dash, immediately back away to create distance.
notes.vs-riven-cc: Riven's combo relies on tightly chaining abilities and basic attacks. Riven is vulnerable to roots or silences during her combo that interrupt her remaining Q and W casts. Use crowd control right after Riven reaches you.
notes.vs-riven-physical: Riven deals all her damage as physical damage. If Riven starts getting ahead, buy armor items sooner to reduce her physical damage.
notes.vs-riven-wave: Counterattack when Riven uses Q to clear minions. After using Q on the wave, Riven loses her main damage and escape tools. Before Riven gets ability haste items, make use of the long window while Q is on cooldown.
notes.vs-riven-ult: Riven gains attack damage while R is active. Expect Riven to land abilities from farther away than usual while R is active. If Wind Slash is still available, being low on health is dangerous even near your turret. When Riven activates R, keep your distance until it expires.
notes.vs-riven-channel: Riven's Q3 and W interrupt channeled ultimates. Avoid starting a channel while Riven is close to you. Start channeling after you see Riven use up Q or use W.
notes.rumble-combo-basic: For a basic trade, fire both E shots, then use Q. Landing the second E on an enemy slowed by the first greatly amplifies the slow and magic resistance reduction. If you activate Q after landing only one E, the enemy can walk out of range.
notes.rumble-combo-heat: In fights, enter the Danger Zone with one E shot, then use Q. Most of Rumble's damage relies on his empowered Q in the Danger Zone. Avoid using abilities blindly, and leave enough Heat capacity to activate Q.
notes.rumble-combo-r: Cut off the escape route with R, then slow the enemy with E and use Q. Drag while casting R to adjust its trajectory. Set R's final angle based on where the enemy will flee. In fights you are already winning, use R to cut off escape routes.
notes.rumble-skill-passive: Heat rises each time you use an ability. Heat decreases when you do nothing. Check your current Heat and choose your ability order to stay in the Danger Zone. If you can secure the kill in melee range, deliberately overheat to use empowered basic attacks. While overheated, the silence limits your ability to escape using abilities.
notes.rumble-skill-q: While Q is active, move and turn to keep the enemy inside its cone. Q deals reduced damage to minions. Manage Q so you do not use it all on farming when you need it for trades. Q's max health damage makes it especially strong against tanks.
notes.rumble-skill-w: W provides both a shield and a brief movement speed boost. With no mobility ability, Rumble relies on W's movement speed boost to engage and disengage. In the Danger Zone, both W's shield and movement speed boost are increased. After building Heat, use W as you close in on the enemy.
notes.rumble-skill-e: E can store up to two shots. Landing both E shots in succession amplifies the slow, letting you keep the enemy within Q range. E's magic resistance reduction also boosts allied mages' damage. Avoid standing in front of the wave after using both E shots, as you have fewer ways to approach or escape.
notes.rumble-skill-r: Draw R between the enemy frontline and backline to separate them. Once a fight has started, use R to cut off the enemy's retreat. R is most effective in narrow passages. Check the terrain in front of objectives beforehand to find narrow passages to block with R.
notes.rumble-laning: In lane, safely chip away at the enemy's health with E. When the enemy steps forward to last-hit, slow them with E and approach with Q. Avoid activating Q first if you have no opening to get close to the enemy.
notes.rumble-laning-gank: Rumble is very vulnerable to ganks because he has no mobility ability and needs to step forward to play. If you have pushed the lane too far, check river vision first. In areas without vision, save W for escape.
notes.rumble-phase: Rumble is at a major disadvantage against magic damage opponents from levels 1–2. You can take early trades against melee opponents who deal physical damage. Rumble's ability to influence lanes increases greatly at level 6, when he learns R. Rumble is strongest in the mid game as he builds ability power. In the late game, Rumble's weakness is getting killed easily before he can reach the enemy.
notes.rumble-teamfight: Find a position just in front of the enemy frontline where Q can hit multiple enemies. Avoid trying to assassinate the backline, as you have no way to dive that deep. Reduce the enemy's magic resistance with E to increase allied mages' damage. In teamfights, always follow your frontline after they engage.
notes.rumble-situational-mr: If the enemy's main damage is magic, buy Force of Nature between core items to give yourself more time to stay close. Rumble's damage depends on how long he survives while staying close to the enemy.
notes.rumble-situational-antiheal: If the enemy's self-healing offsets Q's damage over time, buy Morellonomicon to reduce their healing. Rumble builds up damage by continuously burning enemies.
notes.vs-rumble-range: Q deals damage in a close-range cone. Rumble has no mobility ability. Limit the time Rumble stays close to you to reduce the damage you take. Create situations where Rumble has to walk forward to trade.
notes.vs-rumble-e: Getting hit by both E shots in succession greatly amplifies the slow, making it hard to walk away. As soon as the first E hits, immediately make the call to create distance. If you have a mobility ability, use it before the second E arrives.
notes.vs-rumble-w: W provides both a shield and a brief movement speed boost. Focus your burst damage after Rumble's W shield expires. Once Rumble has used W as well, treat his escape tools as spent.
notes.vs-rumble-hp: Q deals damage based on the target's maximum health. To counter Q's max health damage, choose items with magic resistance over defensive items that only provide health. Rumble is prone to giving up an early advantage in lane against magic damage champions.
notes.ryze-combo-core: The basic combo is E to apply a mark, then Q. Q deals increased damage to an E-marked target and bounces to nearby marked targets. Using another ability resets Q's cooldown. For damage, focus on the right ability order instead of pressing them quickly.
notes.ryze-combo-root: Use E, then W for a guaranteed root. W only slows a target without an E mark. Even when you need to stop an opponent quickly, don't use W first.
notes.ryze-combo-full: For an all-in, use E → W → Q → E → Q. The first Q consumes the mark, so reapply it with E before the second Q. When calculating mana for an all-in combo, account for casting E twice.
notes.ryze-combo-rune-ms: Q grants a large movement speed boost when cast with two runes charged. To close in or escape, stack two runes with E and W, then use Q. Time Q according to whether you need maximum damage or survivability.
notes.ryze-skill-e-spread: E has a very short cooldown, and its mark spreads around the enemy it hits. Just before a fight, use E on a minion or frontliner to set up Q's area damage. Don't repeatedly spend mana on E without a purpose. Don't hold back E when preparing for a teamfight.
notes.ryze-skill-q-aim: Q travels in a straight line and hits only the first target. Mark an opponent among the minions with E, then use Q when they step out of the wave. Q without a mark has neither increased damage nor a bounce.
notes.ryze-skill-passive-mana: The bonus mana from Ryze's passive also contributes to his damage. When mana runs low, it's hard to continue a combo, and the remaining abilities deal less damage. During the laning phase, check your remaining mana before deciding whether to poke.
notes.ryze-skill-r-cast: R activates after a short delay following its cast. Moving or using other abilities while R is charging does not cancel the cast. Being immobilized or unable to use abilities while R is charging cancels the cast. Cast R from a safe spot outside enemy vision, and deal damage until it activates.
notes.ryze-skill-r-use: R transports nearby allies with Ryze. Use R to ambush at objectives. Use R to join allies who are far away. Use R to leave after a teamfight. Tell your allies before using R so they can travel with you.
notes.ryze-phase: Ryze needs both levels and items to become strong. Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so his kill stats are among the lowest. His early CS stats rank near the top. Early on, focus on keeping up your growth rather than getting kills. From the mid to late game, once key mana items are completed, the damage from one combo cycle increases.
notes.ryze-laning: During the laning phase, clear the wave with E, then secure last hits with Q. Poke right after your opponent uses an ability on the wave. When poking, use a quick E → Q, then back off. When your mana falls below half, stop trading damage and just manage the wave.
notes.ryze-laning-push: E clears waves quickly, making it easy to push the lane. Roaming on foot costs you a lot. After level 6, push the lane, then use R to join your allies.
notes.ryze-teamfight: In teamfights, spread E marks through the frontline, then deal area damage with Q. Ryze's range is not especially long, so you may need to step forward during teamfights. Move in second, after an ally uses an engage ability.
notes.ryze-situational-zhonya: If the enemy has an assassin who dives in, buy Zhonya's Hourglass earlier, between your core items. If an assassin who dives in catches you, it's hard to buy time to use your combo.
notes.vs-ryze-flux: Q deals increased damage to an E-marked target and bounces to nearby targets. If E hits you, keep your distance from allies until the mark expires.
notes.vs-ryze-root: Ryze's W roots a target marked by E. W only slows a target that has not been hit by E. Against Ryze, prioritize dodging E.
notes.vs-ryze-ult: Ryze's R takes time to activate after he casts it. Immobilizing Ryze or preventing him from using abilities before R activates cancels it. When you see Realm Warp, anticipate what may arrive at its destination. When you see Realm Warp, interrupt Ryze's cast.
notes.vs-ryze-noescape: Use a gap closer or strong crowd control to reach Ryze first and deny him time to use his combo. If you give Ryze space and take sustained damage, his marks keep refreshing and put you at a disadvantage.
notes.vs-ryze-early: Early on, Ryze lacks mana and damage, so his kill stats rank near the bottom. Pressure Ryze in lane before he completes his items to slow his growth.
notes.samira-skill-passive-grade: Hitting an enemy champion with a different type of attack from the one you last hit them with raises your Style rank by one. Alternate different types of attacks among basic attacks, Q, W, and E to build your Style rank to S in one fight. Each increase in Style rank grants movement speed.
notes.samira-combo-eq: Press Q during your E dash to hit enemies along its path at once. Press Q when using E into a group of overlapping enemies. Using Q separately after E ends hits only one target.
notes.samira-skill-melee-range: Samira deals her full damage within melee range. At melee range, Q becomes a sword slash instead of a gunshot. At melee range, her passive adds magic damage based on the target's missing health. Create an opening to get close enough to deal damage.
notes.samira-combo-cc-dash: Basic attacking an immobilized enemy makes you dash to them even from maximum basic attack range. Be within basic attack range when your support uses an engage ability.
notes.samira-skill-r: R can only be used at Style rank S. Using R immediately resets your Style rank. Use R as soon as you reach Style rank S. Each shot of R applies life steal, so hitting more enemies increases your healing.
notes.samira-skill-w: W destroys enemy projectiles that enter its area. Time W against the enemy marksman's basic attacks or projectile abilities. If the enemy has a crucial projectile, build Style with basic attacks, Q, and E, and save W for defense.
notes.samira-skill-e: E passes through enemies and structures, letting you chase or escape past turrets. When a kill is certain, use E to engage, knowing it will reset. If a kill is uncertain, save E to escape.
notes.samira-combo-allin: Follow your support's crowd control with a basic attack to close the gap, then build Style with Q, a basic attack, E, a basic attack, and W. Use R at S. Once you reach the enemy, alternate attack types to build Style.
notes.samira-laning: Samira has short range for a marksman, so trading damage with ranged poke champions can easily put her behind. When facing ranged poke, give up on building Style and farm under your turret. In a poke matchup, engage when the enemy support steps forward or your jungler intervenes. Against a melee composition, or with engage crowd control from your support, take control from level 2.
notes.samira-laning-trade: Fight within melee range to get a worthwhile damage trade. Only engage with E when your support's crowd control or Flash is available. Repeat short trades where you get close, raise your Style rank by two or three steps, then back off.
notes.samira-phase: Once you have Q and E at level 2, your first all-in opportunity opens up. Learning R at level 6 gives you the power to turn a fight around. Samira peaks in the mid game as she builds critical strike items. In the late game, enemy defensive items and crowd control mean you need allies to create an opening for you to engage.
notes.samira-teamfight: Do not engage first in teamfights. Before diving into the middle of several enemies, reach Style rank S so you can use R.
notes.samira-situational-cc: If the enemy has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, buy Quicksilver Sash between core items to reduce the damage lost when R is interrupted. If you are immobilized during R, the remaining shots are lost and your reset Style rank does not return.
notes.samira-situational-antiheal: If the enemy frontline sustains through healing, choose Mortal Reminder for your armor penetration item slot. Samira's abilities do not apply Grievous Wounds. If you only need armor penetration and not Grievous Wounds, stick with Lord Dominik's Regards.
notes.vs-samira-grade: Samira can only use R at the highest Style rank. Take one type of attack, then disengage or move out of range to stop Samira from raising her Style rank. Limit the time Samira can stay close to prevent her from using her ultimate.
notes.vs-samira-cc-dash: If Samira basic attacks an immobilized ally, she dashes to that ally. Prioritize dodging engage crowd control from enemies near Samira. When an ally is immobilized, expect Samira to dash to them and respond accordingly.
notes.vs-samira-w: Projectiles are destroyed while Samira's W is spinning. Use projectile abilities and basic attacks after W stops spinning. Instant abilities and area abilities that are not projectiles can still hit while W is spinning.
notes.vs-samira-r-interrupt: Samira fires R while staying in place and heals through life steal. Interrupt Samira's R with immobilizing crowd control or a knockback. If R is interrupted, the remaining shots are lost, but her already reset Style rank does not return.
notes.vs-samira-e-reset: E resets immediately if an enemy Samira damaged dies shortly afterward. When retreating from a teamfight, do not leave a low-health ally behind. If Samira engages with E and no one dies, take her down then.
notes.vs-samira-range: Samira has short range for a marksman and deals most of her damage at melee range. If you outrange her, keep poking without stepping forward to limit Samira's chances to build Style. In lane, watch for openings that let Samira walk into range.
notes.sejuani-combo-gank: During a gank, knock the target up with Q, build stacks with W, stun with E, then auto-attack. Auto-attack immediately after the E stun to trigger the passive's bonus damage.
notes.sejuani-combo-walkup: If the target has a mobility ability, save Q when engaging. Walk in, build stacks with W, and stun with E. Use Q to follow when the target escapes with a mobility ability. Q's knockup is brief, and using it to engage leaves you without an escape.
notes.sejuani-combo-r: R stuns longer when it travels farther before hitting. Throw R from as far away as possible. After R hits, engage with Q while its area slow remains, then follow with W and E. Approach from the side so a champion in front does not take the R instead.
notes.sejuani-skill-passive: Frost Armor activates after Sejuani avoids damage from champions and large jungle monsters for a set time, granting slow immunity and defensive stats. Just before a fight, avoid hitting camps and wait for Frost Armor to activate. Auto-attack stunned enemies to deal the passive's damage based on their maximum health.
notes.sejuani-skill-q: Q can be used for movement and to start fights. Q can interrupt channeled abilities. Q stops when it hits an enemy champion but passes through minions. When using Q to cross a wall or escape, check that no enemy champion is in your path.
notes.sejuani-skill-w: W swings twice, with most of its damage and its slow on the second hit. When using W, land the second hit too. W's first hit pushes minions and jungle monsters, which can hurt camp clears. Max W first for its second-hit damage and faster stack building.
notes.sejuani-skill-e: E can only be used on a target with full stacks. W and Sejuani's auto-attacks build stacks. Nearby allied melee champions' auto-attacks also build E stacks. Watch which target an allied melee champion is attacking to see who will be ready for an E stun. E targets the enemy closest to your cursor. Stacks cannot build again for a while on an enemy stunned by E.
notes.sejuani-skill-r: When no allies are nearby, use Q to buy time instead of R.
notes.sejuani-laning-path: Her early kills and damage per minute are low, so jungle routes aimed at early kills do not suit her. Early on, clear camps safely to gain levels. Start fights in lanes where your ally already has the advantage. Move with Frost Armor active to prepare for counterjungling.
notes.sejuani-laning-gank: Gank lanes pushed toward the enemy turret, where the enemy has a long way to retreat. Avoid hitting camps right before a gank so Frost Armor stays active. Allied melee champions' auto-attacks build E stacks, letting you stun sooner during a gank. The more melee champions on your team, the more likely your ganks are to succeed.
notes.sejuani-phase: Before level 6, ganks are slow because you need full stacks to stun. From level 6, you can start fights with R regardless of stacks. The passive's bonus defensive stats scale with Sejuani's armor and magic resistance, while W's damage scales with her maximum health.
notes.sejuani-teamfight: With Frost Armor active, cast R at an angle that reaches the enemy backline damage dealer. When R hits, follow in with Q and hold the target down with W and E. Engage when your allied damage dealers can immediately damage the R target. If your allied damage dealers cannot follow up, use W from the front to slow the enemy's engage and save R.
notes.sejuani-situational-mr: If the enemy's damage is mostly magic, include Spirit Visage in your core build order to make use of the passive's magic resistance increase.
notes.sejuani-situational-armor: If the enemy has strong physical damage and many champions who stick to targets with auto-attacks, buy Thornmail early to build up reflected damage while taking hits.
notes.vs-sejuani-frost: When Sejuani is nearby, watch for stun stacks if you are close to one of her melee allies. Create distance immediately when the Permafrost stack indicator fills up.
notes.vs-sejuani-passive: Sejuani is immune to slows and has increased defensive stats while Frost Armor is active. When escaping, damage Sejuani first to remove her slow immunity, then use your escape ability.
notes.vs-sejuani-q-r: Q stops when it hits an allied champion in front, so it cannot reach those behind them. R stuns longer when it travels farther before hitting. If R is going to hit you, close the distance so it hits at short range. When you see Q or R wind up, move sideways to dodge.
notes.vs-sejuani-w: Most of W's damage and its slow are on the second hit. If W's first hit lands, move out of range before the second hit.
notes.vs-sejuani-e: Stacks cannot build again for a while on a target stunned by E. Once the E stun has been used, there is a brief safe window when stacks cannot build. When the stun ends, create distance immediately to avoid Sejuani's first auto-attack.
notes.vs-sejuani-scaling: Sejuani's damage and defenses scale with her health and defensive stats. Sejuani ranks near the bottom in early kills and damage. Take early jungle control and objectives to delay Sejuani's item completion.
notes.senna-skill-souls: Senna grows by collecting Mist through her passive, Absolution. When a unit dies near Senna, it has a chance to leave a soul behind. Attack a soul to collect Mist. Souls disappear over time, so watch where they appear and collect them. Support Senna gains attack damage from Mist without taking CS.
notes.senna-skill-mist-champ: Hit the same enemy champion twice with attacks or abilities to gain Mist. Hit the same enemy champion twice with attacks or abilities to deal bonus damage based on their current health. When you have a safe chance to poke, take it. Combine one attack and one Q in a single approach to gain Mist.
notes.senna-skill-range-growth: At certain Mist thresholds, Senna gains attack range and critical strike chance. In the late game, Senna's increased range lets her attack before other marksmen. As your range grows, position to make use of it when attacking.
notes.senna-skill-q: Q travels in a straight line through the targeted ally or enemy. If you cannot hit an opponent directly with Q, target a minion in front of them to hit them behind it. Q's cast range scales with attack range. Q's cast time scales with attack speed.
notes.senna-skill-q-cooldown: Each attack reduces Q's cooldown. After using Q, follow up with two attacks to reduce its cooldown. Instead of saving Q only for urgent ally healing, use attacks to reduce its cooldown.
notes.senna-skill-w: W attaches to the first target it hits, then roots nearby targets after a short delay. Minions block W. Account for W's delayed root and aim where the opponent is going. Hit grouped opponents with W to root several at once.
notes.senna-skill-e: Allies inside E's mist are camouflaged too. Allies who leave E's mist become wraiths that conceal their identities. Use E just before a teamfight and approach with your allies to make it harder for opponents to target them. Use E when engaging with allies, not just to escape.
notes.senna-combo-pick: When you have a chance to kill, land W, then time Q and an attack with the root. Time the delay between W's hit and root with an ally's engage ability.
notes.senna-combo-teamfight: To start a teamfight, approach with allies using E, root opponents in the center with W, then use R. R's ally shield covers a wider area than its damage hitbox. Aim R so allies are also within the beam's width.
notes.senna-skill-r: R is an area beam that extends beyond the screen. R's shield strength scales with the amount of Mist collected.
notes.senna-phase: Senna can die easily if caught early. Senna becomes more impactful from the mid game onward as Mist increases her attack damage and range. In the late game, Senna deals damage from a safe position using her range advantage. Collect Mist early without dying.
notes.senna-laning-souls: Stepping forward to collect a soul is the most dangerous moment. Check both the soul's position and the range of enemy abilities. Step forward to collect a soul when key enemy abilities are on cooldown. Avoid last-hitting minions so you do not take CS from your allied marksman.
notes.senna-laning-trade: Senna attacks slowly and has a long pause after each attack. Do not aim for consecutive attacks when poking in lane. Land an attack followed by Q to gain Mist, then retreat immediately.
notes.senna-teamfight: In teamfights, heal allies with Q from the backline. In teamfights, attack from the backline using your increased range. Hold W to stop an enemy engage. If you cannot use W on an approaching enemy, use it when it lines up with an ally's engage ability. In teamfights, Senna should only move forward when engaging with E.
notes.vs-senna-souls: Senna's growth depends on collecting souls. When a soul appears, watch for Senna to step forward. Check where the soul is, wait nearby, then harass Senna. Pressure Senna into giving up souls.
notes.vs-senna-mist-stacks: If Senna hits you twice with attacks or abilities, she gains Mist. If Senna hits you once, retreat immediately to avoid the second hit.
notes.vs-senna-w: Senna's W has a delay between hitting and rooting. When Senna's W attaches to you, its mark is visible until the root triggers. If W marks you, move away from your allies immediately. In lane, stand behind minions to block Senna's W.
notes.vs-senna-q: Senna's Q extends in a straight line through a targeted ally or minion. Do not stand in a straight line with Senna and an allied champion of hers. Do not stand in a straight line with Senna and a minion in front of you.
notes.vs-senna-early: Senna is vulnerable to early pressure. Pressure Senna hard in lane to prevent her from collecting Mist. If you leave Senna alone early, her range and attack damage will keep growing.
notes.vs-senna-e: When you see Senna's mist, back away to an area where you have vision. Use area abilities on Senna's mist to block her approach.
notes.seraphine-combo-cc-chain: E roots enemies who are already slowed. E stuns enemies who are immobilized. Apply a slow from yourself or an ally first, then root them with E. If you land E first without a slow, it only slows.
notes.seraphine-combo-passive-echo: The passive casts every third basic ability twice. If both hits of Echo E land, the first E slows and the second roots. Count your basic ability casts before a fight to line up Echo with E or W.
notes.seraphine-combo-ult-range: R also extends its range when it hits an allied champion. In teamfights, cast R through allies lined up in front of you. Allies hit by R gain a full stack of Notes.
notes.seraphine-combo-ult-follow: Charm with R, root with E, then finish with Q. Using Q before E costs you damage based on missing health.
notes.seraphine-skill-q: Q deals more damage the more health the target is missing. Use Q to finish low-health enemies or clear waves.
notes.seraphine-skill-w-double: If you use W again while your shield is still active, it also heals. Echo W provides both a shield and a heal in one cast. Before a major fight, line up Echo with W.
notes.seraphine-skill-w-timing: W also increases allies' movement speed. Use W as you engage or retreat to make use of its movement speed and shield.
notes.seraphine-skill-e-save: E is Seraphine's only reliable crowd control. Save E for an ally's engage or to stop an enemy's dash. E deals reduced damage to minions. Don't use E to clear waves.
notes.seraphine-phase: Seraphine can poke comfortably in lane thanks to her ability range and Notes from allies. Seraphine struggles to get kills alone. Her teamfight impact rises sharply after learning R at level 6. Seraphine is strongest in the mid to late game as she builds ability power. Never stand in front at any stage of the game.
notes.seraphine-laning-notes: Passive Notes stack based on the number of nearby allies, increasing basic attack range and damage.
notes.seraphine-laning-mana: Q and W cost a lot of mana, so excessive early poke can leave you unable to use E and W when you need them. Trade when the enemy stops to last-hit a minion. When you aren't trading, focus on positioning and securing vision.
notes.seraphine-teamfight: In teamfights, stay behind your allies and protect them with W. Send E through grouped enemies to root them. If R can reach the enemy backline, use it just before your allies engage.
notes.seraphine-teamfight-ult-defense: R's charm can turn an engaging enemy back as a defensive tool. If your carry gets jumped, use R immediately instead of waiting to hit multiple enemies.
notes.seraphine-situational-mikael: If the enemy team has a lot of reliable crowd control, get Mikael's Blessing earlier. If an ally is caught in crowd control, they may die before Seraphine's shield and heal can reach them.
notes.vs-seraphine-e: Seraphine's E roots enemies who are already slowed. Seraphine's E stuns enemies who are immobilized. As soon as you're slowed, move out of the line directly in front of Seraphine.
notes.vs-seraphine-ult: Seraphine's R extends its range each time it hits an allied champion. In teamfights, spread out sideways so Seraphine's R can't pass through you in a line.
notes.vs-seraphine-passive: Seraphine needs nearby allies to stack Notes, increasing her basic attack range and damage. Trade when Seraphine is standing alone, away from her marksman.
notes.vs-seraphine-fragile: Seraphine has no mobility ability. After Seraphine uses E, she has virtually no way to defend herself. Engage right after Seraphine misses E.
notes.sett-combo-basic: For a basic trade, use two Q-empowered attacks, then E and W in order. Q has no cast time, so using it between attacks or while moving keeps your attack rhythm intact. Use Q as your attacks connect, rather than activating it before getting in range. Immediately line up W with the enemies pulled together by E to guarantee a center-line hit.
notes.sett-combo-r: For an R engage combo, use E and W after landing, then finish with Q-empowered attacks. R moves the grabbed target forward in the direction Sett is facing. To send an enemy into the middle of your team, use R with your back to your allies. The strong slow around R's landing point makes the follow-up E easier to aim.
notes.sett-skill-passive: Sett's passive right punch hits harder and faster than his left punch. When trading basic attacks, finish with the right punch before backing off. Sett's passive increases his health regeneration as his missing health increases. Even after taking damage, consider using his passive healing to stay in lane.
notes.sett-skill-q: Q empowers your next two attacks. Q increases movement speed when walking toward enemy champions. Use Q the moment you start chasing a fleeing enemy. Use both Q-empowered attacks on champions instead of minions. Q's damage cap per punch against monsters limits its contribution to jungle clearing.
notes.sett-skill-w-grit: W stores Grit based on the damage Sett takes. W's Grit rapidly decays shortly after taking damage. To maximize W's shield and damage, use it immediately after taking a major enemy ability. W provides almost no shield when Grit is empty. In lane, consider deliberately taking some poke to build Grit.
notes.sett-skill-w-aim: W deals true damage only to enemies on its center line. W deals physical damage to enemies outside its center line. Aim W's center line precisely at tanks with high armor. W grants its shield before the punch goes out. When you urgently need to survive, use W for the shield before worrying about aim.
notes.sett-skill-e: E only stuns if it grabs at least one enemy on each side. E only slows if it grabs enemies on just one side. E can affect all enemy units, including champions. Position between minions and the enemy champion to land an E stun even in a 1v1.
notes.sett-laning-trade: When trading against melee opponents, wait for them to use an ability instead of engaging first. Sett's trading efficiency depends on the Grit he builds before striking back.
notes.sett-laning-ranged: Sett struggles to reach ranged opponents before learning R. Against ranged opponents, give up trading and pull the wave toward your turret to farm. Against ranged opponents, only attempt guaranteed crowd control with E and R when your jungler comes. Avoid forcing your way toward ranged opponents and losing health while out of range.
notes.sett-phase: Sett has a weak period at levels 1–2. Sett reaches his first power spike at level 3, when he has Q, W, and E. Sett reaches his second power spike at level 6, when he learns R. Sett peaks in the mid game, when health items increase his Grit capacity. In the late game, Sett's impact depends on R usage because he struggles to reach ranged formations.
notes.sett-teamfight-entry: Instead of starting a teamfight, enter one already underway while building Grit. In narrow passages, pull multiple enemies into a line with E, then hit them with W's center line. Avoid frontal engages in open areas, where you can easily die before getting in range.
notes.sett-teamfight-r: R's damage scales with the grabbed target's bonus health. To increase R's damage, target a frontline enemy with health items. A target grabbed by R is suppressed and cannot escape with movement abilities. If you have an angle to move a key damage dealer into the middle of your team, prioritize disrupting their formation over R's damage.
notes.sett-situational-mr: Buy an early Null-Magic Mantle to reduce losses in early trades against magic damage opponents. Against magic damage opponents, buy a magic resistance item after completing your first core item.
notes.sett-situational-antiheal: Buy Executioner's Calling if the enemy's healing is enough to turn trades around. Sett deals damage through multiple empowered attacks, making healing reduction easy to maintain.
notes.vs-sett-w: Sett's W grows stronger the more damage he takes. Treat the moment right after using major abilities on Sett as when his W is most dangerous. After damaging Sett, back away and approach again once his Grit has fallen. If you cannot dodge all of W, move sideways to avoid the center line's true damage.
notes.vs-sett-e: Sett's E only stuns if it grabs enemies on both sides. To avoid E's stun, avoid standing opposite an ally with Sett between you. Sett's E only applies a brief slow if it grabs enemies on just one side.
notes.vs-sett-r: If Sett grabs you with R, Flash and Cleanse cannot remove the suppression. Items that remove crowd control, such as Mercurial Scimitar, can remove Sett's R suppression. Sett's R damage scales with the grabbed target's bonus health. While Sett has R available, stack with your allies to leave no room to be thrown.
notes.vs-sett-mobility: Sett relies on R to close the gap on opponents. Maintain your range and repeatedly poke Sett. When Sett starts walking toward you, retreat before his movement speed increases. Account for the fact that poke damage turns into Sett's W shield.
notes.vs-sett-mr: As a magic damage champion, look for aggressive trades around Sett's level 3. Build an early health advantage to give Sett fewer chances to build Grit.
notes.shaco-combo-box-camp: Place W before starting a jungle camp, then attack while the monsters are feared. W's fear lasts much longer on monsters than on champions. Use W during early jungle clears to lose less health. W has a fairly short cooldown, so using one at each camp won't slow your clear.
notes.shaco-combo-gank: When ganking, place W on the escape route, use Q to get behind the target, land an empowered basic attack, then finish with E. When entering with Q, position yourself so the empowered basic attack hits the target from behind. The empowered basic attack from behind after Q is a critical strike. Place W in the direction the target will flee to block their escape.
notes.shaco-skill-passive: P Backstab activates when you attack a target from behind. P Backstab applies to E as well as basic attacks. The lower the target's health, the more bonus damage P adds to E. Get behind the target to deal more damage.
notes.shaco-skill-q: Q provides a short teleport and invisibility. You can cross walls with Q. Your first basic attack during Q's invisibility is empowered. Your first basic attack from behind after Q is a critical strike. If you use Q to engage, its long cooldown makes it hard to use again to escape that fight. If you cannot secure the kill, save Q to escape. Turrets and true sight reveal Q's invisibility.
notes.shaco-skill-w-vision: W disappears from sight shortly after placement and lasts a long time. Place W early at entrances to your jungle, around objectives, and in bushes enemies may pass through to gain vision. Place W on an enemy's approach path to block their entry. Leveling W increases its fear duration against champions.
notes.shaco-skill-w-objective: Before starting Dragon or Rift Herald, place W at each entrance enemies could use. If an enemy jungler coming to steal an objective is feared by W, their Smite timing is disrupted. When W triggers, it warns you that an enemy is approaching. Delay starting the objective if you need time to place W.
notes.shaco-skill-e: While E is off cooldown, your basic attacks slow. When chasing an enemy, hold E to keep the slow on your basic attacks. E's active deals much more damage when the target is low on health. Use E to finish targets from range.
notes.shaco-skill-r: Shaco briefly disappears while creating his clone with R. Use the moment Shaco disappears during R to dodge an enemy's targeted ability. The R clone takes increased damage and does not last long. The R clone explodes when it dies and leaves three small boxes that trigger immediately. The R clone applies on-hit effects. Control the R clone separately by holding Alt and right-clicking.
notes.shaco-combo-r-teamfight: In teamfights, send the R clone toward the enemy backline to draw attention, then use Q to get behind them from the other side. Engage when the R clone explodes and the small boxes trigger their fear. Do not keep the R clone beside Shaco, or both may be hit by the same area-of-effect ability.
notes.shaco-jungle-path: Shaco is a jungler who gets ahead through kill participation more than farming. Clear camps safely with W, then use the health you saved for ganks and jungle invades. Place W in front of enemy camps to prepare for invades and gain vision against counter-invades.
notes.shaco-phase: At levels 1–2, use W to clear camps safely. Once you have both Q and E at level 3, you can make your first gank. Shaco's burst damage peaks in the mid game with two items. With two items in the mid game, look for chances to pick off enemy backliners alone. Shaco's ability to win solo fights falls off late game. When enemies have vision late game, Shaco has fewer angles to engage from. Late game, use W and the R clone to disrupt enemy vision and apply pressure. Shaco can easily fall behind the pace of the game if he fails to gain an early advantage.
notes.shaco-teamfight: Avoid head-on teamfights. Shaco is fragile and can easily fall to a few area-of-effect abilities. Draw fights into areas where you have already placed W. Send the R clone ahead to draw attention, then target the enemy backline from the side. Engage when an enemy damage dealer steps forward.
notes.shaco-situational-antiheal: If a target you need to pick off survives through healing, buy Executioner's Calling early. If an enemy heals during Shaco's burst, you may lack the damage to kill them.
notes.shaco-situational-cc: Consider Quicksilver Sash if the enemy has a lot of crowd control that prevents movement. If Shaco is immobilized before he can use Q to escape, he is easy to catch where he engaged.
notes.vs-shaco-q-commit: Right after Shaco engages with Q, he cannot immediately use it again to escape. When Shaco appears after Q, focus him immediately with your allies. If you miss the opening right after Shaco engages with Q, he may recover and disappear out of vision again.
notes.vs-shaco-box: Assume W is in unwarded bushes and around objectives. W becomes invisible shortly after placement. Clear W in advance with Control Wards and Oracle Lens. If you cannot clear W, start the objective from a position where you have room to retreat even if feared. Starting an objective fight while feared by W disrupts Smite timing.
notes.vs-shaco-backstab: Shaco deals much more damage when attacking a target from behind. If Shaco is nearby, put your back to a wall or face toward your allies to make it harder for him to get behind you.
notes.vs-shaco-clone: The R clone takes increased damage and dies faster than Shaco. The R clone explodes when it dies and leaves three small boxes that trigger immediately. After killing the R clone, back away to avoid the explosion and fear. Watch how the health bars react to tell the R clone from Shaco.
notes.vs-shaco-execute: E deals much more damage when the target is low on health. If you have little health left after a fight, avoid unwarded jungle areas and bushes.
notes.vs-shaco-early: Shaco is a jungler who gains advantages through early ganks and invades. Early on, avoid giving Shaco kills, take objectives, and buy time. Shaco's ability to win solo fights falls off late game. Keep vision at entrances to your jungle to stop Shaco's early ganks and invades.
notes.shen-combo-basic: The basic combo is Q, then E to taunt, followed by three basic attacks. Q empowers several of your next basic attacks instead of dealing immediate damage. After using Q, land your empowered basic attacks. Use Q before E to land empowered basic attacks during the taunt. Using Q and E in succession reduces the health you lose right after engaging through your passive shield.
notes.shen-skill-blade: Shen's ability use depends heavily on the spirit blade's position. Q calls the spirit blade toward Shen, hitting enemies in its path. W's zone appears at the spirit blade's location. R moves Shen and the spirit blade together.
notes.shen-skill-q: If the blade returning with Q hits an enemy champion, your empowered basic attacks deal more damage and your attack speed increases. When trading with a tank, position yourself so the blade passes through them. Q deals more damage to jungle monsters. Use Q to clear camps and objectives.
notes.shen-skill-w: W blocks basic attacks but does not block ability damage. Use W against opponents who rely on basic attacks. If there is no allied champion to protect inside the zone, W takes a moment to activate. Do not cast W early where there is no champion to protect.
notes.shen-skill-e: E taunts enemies and lets Shen move during fights. Save E to respond when an opponent engages. Engage with E first only when you are sure you can win. If E misses, it gives the opponent time to counterattack.
notes.shen-skill-passive: Shen gains his passive shield when he uses an ability. Hitting an allied or enemy champion with an ability reduces the cooldown of his passive shield. In lane, clip the enemy champion with Q to get your next shield sooner.
notes.shen-skill-r-shield: R's shield grows the more health the targeted ally has lost. Use R after an ally starts taking damage. Before using R, judge whether the targeted ally can survive until the channel ends. R moves Shen to the targeted ally's location. If you decide to use R, tell the targeted ally to hold their position.
notes.shen-laning: Shen ranks near the bottom among top champions in CS and damage per minute. Get through lane safely and use R to help other lanes. Avoid risky trades so you have enough health to use R. Manage the wave safely during laning phase.
notes.shen-laning-energy: Shen uses energy, which regenerates over time. Dealing damage with Q and E restores energy. Against mana users, take repeated short trades to drain their resources first.
notes.shen-laning-wave: When Shen uses R to go to another lane, his own lane is left empty. If a fight looks likely in another lane, push the wave toward the enemy turret before using R. Using R without pushing the wave can cost you heavily in your own lane.
notes.shen-phase: Shen is weakest at levels 1–5, when he lacks damage and mobility. From level 6, when Shen learns R, he can affect the entire map. After level 6, Shen's impact depends heavily on R's cooldown. Shen's real peak comes in the mid to late game as cooldown reduction builds up.
notes.shen-teamfight: In teamfights, use E to taunt enemies off your carries. Position the spirit blade so W's zone appears around your carries. In teamfights, position yourself to protect your backline rather than engage forward. Do not get tied up in a separate 1v1 during a teamfight.
notes.shen-situational-thornmail: If the enemy's main damage is physical and relies heavily on basic attacks, buy Thornmail between core items. Because W blocks basic attacks, Thornmail adds defensive value against opponents who rely on them.
notes.shen-situational-mr: If the enemy's main damage is magic, W can block very little of it. If the enemy's main damage is magic, choose a magic resist item such as Bandlepipes as your third item.
notes.vs-shen-e: E is Shen's main tool for forcing control over opponents and moving during fights. Counterattack right after Shen misses E.
notes.vs-shen-r: From level 6, Shen can join an ally anywhere on the map. If Shen disappears from lane or starts channeling R, alert your team immediately. Start a dive or fight only if you can finish it before Shen arrives. When Shen leaves with R, gain an advantage in his lane.
notes.vs-shen-q: Most of Shen's damage comes from basic attacks empowered by Q. How much Q empowers them depends on whether the returning spirit blade hits a champion. Step out of the spirit blade's path as it returns to Shen. Because Q's damage scales with maximum health, defensive items that only add health are less effective.
notes.vs-shen-w: Shen's W blocks basic attacks but does not block ability damage. As a marksman, keep your distance while W is active and attack again after the zone ends. Champions who rely on ability damage should keep using their abilities even when W is active.
notes.vs-shen-lane: Shen ranks near the bottom in top lane laning stats, so he is likely to lose early trades. Against Shen, prioritize lane control over kills. Push the wave to keep Shen occupied with CS and make him lose out when he uses R to help another lane.
notes.shyvana-combo-clear: At jungle camps, detonate E on the large monster as you approach, then activate W and follow with a Q-empowered auto attack. Stay close to the monster while the shield lasts so the W explosion hits the camp. Jungle monsters do not run away, so you can use W's full duration.
notes.shyvana-combo-gank: For ganks after level 6, pass through the enemy with R, hit them with E as they retreat, and finish with a Q empowered auto attack. You are unstoppable during R's movement, so enemy crowd control cannot interrupt your engage.
notes.shyvana-combo-w-recast: Reactivating W makes it explode before its duration ends. If the enemy looks likely to escape before the shield expires, reactivate W as soon as you reach them. If the enemy stays close, delay the W explosion to use the movement speed boost longer. In dragon form, the W explosion heals you only if it hits a champion.
notes.shyvana-skill-passive: Participating in a champion, large minion, or large monster takedown permanently stacks P's armor and magic resistance. P stacks persist through death. Shyvana has low health growth late in the game, so she becomes less durable without enough P stacks.
notes.shyvana-skill-q: Q empowers your next auto attack. Press Q in time with an auto attack so you do not waste it. Each auto attack that hits reduces Q's cooldown, making attack speed valuable for Shyvana. When targeting a single champion in dragon form, save Q's extra cast.
notes.shyvana-skill-w: W grants a shield and increases your movement speed more as you get closer to enemy champions. When ganking, activate W first to close the gap. W's shield absorbs more damage based on the number of nearby enemy champions.
notes.shyvana-skill-e: In human form, E stops and explodes on the first enemy it hits. To target a champion behind minions, fire E from the side to avoid the minion wave. In dragon form, E's enlarged fireball passes through enemies and leaves flames in its path. When enemies line up in a narrow passage, hit several of them with dragon form E.
notes.shyvana-skill-r-fury: R becomes available through the Fury gauge instead of a cooldown. Auto attacks and ability hits build Fury. Area damage against non-champion targets generates much less Fury. Fury fills much faster in dragon form. Fill your Fury gauge before an objective fight.
notes.shyvana-skill-r-timing: Generally, use R at the start of a fight to benefit from empowered abilities and bonus health throughout it. If the enemy has reliable engage crowd control, you can save R to push through it. Fighting without transforming greatly reduces Shyvana's damage and durability.
notes.shyvana-jungle-path: At level 5 or below, Shyvana has no immobilizing crowd control, so her ganks are less likely to succeed. Early on, use your fast movement between camps to scale through full clears and invasions of camps on the opposite side. Start looking for committed ganks once you have R.
notes.shyvana-objective: Q's damage based on maximum health is effective against high-health epic monsters. Participating in a large monster takedown grants a P stack. Establish vision so you can start Dragon and Rift Herald before the enemy.
notes.shyvana-phase: Levels 1–5 are a farming phase with weak ganks because Shyvana has no crowd control. Once you get R at level 6, you can start fights. Shyvana peaks in the mid game when she has attack speed and core items. Late in the game, she gets taken down early in teamfights if P stacks and defensive items do not make up for her low health growth.
notes.shyvana-teamfight: In teamfights, choose an entry angle that puts several enemies in R's path. Stand among enemy champions so dragon form W's explosion hits several of them. Use the piercing E when enemies group together. Use R on enemies after an ally applies crowd control.
notes.shyvana-situational-antiheal: If the enemy has a lot of healing, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item. Shyvana stays close and attacks for a long time, making her weak against sustained enemy healing. Shyvana's abilities do not apply Grievous Wounds.
notes.vs-shyvana-distance: Keep your distance to avoid Shyvana's Q auto attack and W explosion. If you can keep your distance, be especially wary of Shyvana using R to close the gap.
notes.vs-shyvana-spread: In dragon form, Shyvana can hit several enemies at once with R's path, W's explosion, and her piercing E. Spread out in teamfights to reduce Shyvana's area damage and healing.
notes.vs-shyvana-fury: Shyvana's Fury gauge shows whether she can transform. Pressure Shyvana or start an objective when her Fury gauge is empty. If Shyvana's Fury gauge is full, do not start attacking an objective in front of her.
notes.vs-shyvana-r-unstoppable: Shyvana is unstoppable while flying with R, so crowd control cannot interrupt her entry. Apply crowd control after Shyvana lands with R. Fight back when her transformation ends and she loses the bonus health and empowered abilities.
notes.vs-shyvana-early: At level 5 or below, Shyvana has no immobilizing crowd control, making it hard for her to secure kills with ganks. Early on, Shyvana quickly clears camps and takes objectives while building P stacks. Early on, steal Shyvana's jungle camps and take objectives first to prevent her from gaining P stacks.
notes.singed-combo-fling-glue: Fling the enemy behind you with E, then place W where they land to root them. If you place W first, the enemy can back out of the adhesive.
notes.singed-combo-tower: Near a turret, use E to throw the enemy into turret range, then place W on top of them. Placing W on an enemy inside turret range makes it take longer for them to escape, so they take more turret shots.
notes.singed-combo-flash-fling: Press E during Flash to Fling the enemy as soon as you arrive. Combining Flash and E lets you force an engage despite E's short range. Use the Flash–E combo only for fights you can win.
notes.singed-skill-q: Q toggles on and off and has no cooldown, but drains mana continuously while active. Q leaves poison behind Singed in the direction he moves. With Q active, keep moving and lead the enemy along a path where they'll step in the poison. Turn off Q after the fight to save mana.
notes.singed-skill-w: W slows enemies and prevents them from using movement abilities. Against an enemy escaping with a movement ability, place W along their expected escape path. Rather than saving W, throw it when you read where the enemy will retreat.
notes.singed-skill-e: E deals damage based on maximum health, so it hurts tanky enemies too. Fling the enemy carry toward your team with E. Use E to throw back an enemy attacking your carry. Before using E, check whether the direction you'll throw the enemy favors you. If the enemy is already in the middle of your team, avoid using E to throw them to safety.
notes.singed-skill-r: While R is active, Q's poison reduces healing. Activate R and move as if fleeing to lure the enemy into Q's poison. Use R when an enemy chases Singed because he looks low on health.
notes.singed-skill-passive: P grants movement speed when you pass through allied or enemy champions. P has a separate cooldown for each champion. Zigzag through a group of champions to refresh P's movement speed bonus.
notes.singed-laning-proxy: In lane, focus on keeping your opponent tied to the lane rather than killing them. Push a wave into the enemy turret, then clear the next wave behind it with Q. Clearing the next wave behind the turret keeps the enemy in lane while your teammates can move. Go behind the turret just after the enemy jungler is spotted on the other side of the map.
notes.singed-laning-trade: Pass by the enemy with Q active to lay poison, then Fling them with E if they stand their ground. Don't stand still and trade basic attacks with the enemy. Look for an E right after the enemy uses their escape ability to clear the wave or for another purpose. If the enemy still has their escape ability, they can get away immediately after you Fling them with E.
notes.singed-phase: At levels 1–2, Singed only has Q, so his damage is low and he runs out of mana quickly. At level 3, Singed can combine W and E, giving him his first chance to catch an enemy. At level 6, R completes Singed's ability to escape and lure enemies. After getting two core items, Singed can withstand multiple enemies while pushing the lane. Singed falls off late if he hasn't completed his items.
notes.singed-teamfight: In teamfights, your role is to disrupt the enemy formation. Activate Q, run through the enemy team, refresh your speed with P, then Fling the enemy carry toward your team with E. Keep moving after the Fling so multiple enemies chase Singed. Stay alive as long as possible while they chase.
notes.singed-situational-armor: If most of the enemy's damage is physical, build armor first. Dead Man's Plate provides armor and movement effects that suit catching enemies and running around. Build Plated Steelcaps early to survive against enemies who rely on basic attacks.
notes.singed-situational-tenacity: Choose Quicksilver Sash if the enemy has several immobilizing crowd control abilities. Singed must keep moving to survive and cannot directly remove crowd control with his abilities.
notes.vs-singed-chase: Don't chase Singed just because he looks low on health if you lack the damage to kill him for sure. Chasing Singed means stepping in the Q poison he leaves behind. If Singed has R active, Q's poison also reduces healing.
notes.vs-singed-fling: E sends its target behind Singed.
notes.vs-singed-cc: Attack Singed's teammates while Singed is tied down. Don't chase Singed all the way.
notes.vs-singed-glue: You cannot use movement abilities while standing on W's adhesive. Before trying to dash away, check whether W is under your feet. Getting hit by E while on W roots you. Go around W instead of stepping on it.
notes.vs-singed-proxy: Don't chase Singed behind the turret and fight him one-on-one in the jungle. If Singed is behind the turret, push the empty lane to pressure the turret. If Singed is behind the turret, move to another lane with your jungler to gain a numbers advantage.
notes.vs-singed-early: Take down Singed's health at levels 1–2, when his damage and mana are limited. Pressure Singed early to force him to recall. Once Singed has his core items, he becomes hard to kill and can keep pushing the lane.
notes.sion-combo-setup: For basic poke, slow the target with E, then land Q. Use E to set up Q. If you start Q without E, the opponent has plenty of time to see it and walk out.
notes.sion-combo-engage: When engaging, follow the stun from R's collision with Q, W, then E. After R stuns, charge Q only long enough to knock the target up, then land it. Activate W's shield just before engaging. Detonate W after the opponents group up.
notes.sion-skill-q-charge: Q deals more damage the longer you charge it. After a certain charge time, Q knocks targets up; charging it longer stuns them. Sion moves slowly while charging Q, so opponents can walk out. In lane, release Q as soon as it has charged long enough to knock up. Aim for a fully charged Q when the opponent is already immobilized.
notes.sion-skill-q-target: Q deals reduced damage to minions and greatly increased damage to jungle monsters. Use Q to pressure objectives and the jungle. When taking a large monster with your jungler, save Q for it.
notes.sion-skill-w: After activating its shield, you can recast W a short time later to detonate it. Watch the shield indicator and detonate W just before the shield expires. W's passive permanently increases your maximum health each time you kill a unit. Last-hit units to build up maximum health.
notes.sion-skill-e: E stops at the first target it hits, but pushes a minion or monster backward if it hits one. Enemies struck by a unit pushed by E take the same damage and effects. In lane, use E to push a minion toward the opponent and hit them. When engaging with an allied physical damage dealer, use E first to reduce the target's armor.
notes.sion-skill-r: Sion is unstoppable while charging with R, but can only steer a little. Use R on straight paths and avoid curved ones. R deals more damage and stuns longer the farther Sion travels. Recast R to stop before colliding with the wrong target. R also stops when it hits a wall.
notes.sion-skill-passive: During his post-death revival, all abilities are replaced by one, his attack speed and life steal increase greatly, and his hits deal damage based on maximum health. Before dying, decide what to do during the revival. During the revival, attack a turret, push a wave, or buy time for allies to retreat.
notes.sion-laning: At 14 minutes, Sion is among the champions with the fewest kills and the fewest deaths. In lane, focus on farming safely and stacking maximum health with W rather than getting kills. Use E to push minions into the opponent for poke. In lane, use Q when the opponent is immobilized. Even if you lose a trade, secure CS and turret plates.
notes.sion-phase: At levels 1–2, Sion struggles to apply pressure with just one ability. His first power spike comes at level 6, after putting points into Q and unlocking R. Sion is strongest in the mid to late game, when the maximum health stacked through W combines with defensive items. In the mid to late game, his revival passive lets him effectively fight twice even if he dies. If he falls far behind early, he lacks the damage to turn things around on his own.
notes.sion-teamfight-engage: Start R from fog of war or behind a wall, where the opponent cannot see you. Use R to charge toward the enemy backline. Before using R, check that your allies are close enough to follow.
notes.sion-teamfight-role: In teamfights, use E from the frontline to reduce enemy armor. In teamfights, keep enemies pinned down with Q's area stun and W's explosion. In teamfights, fall in a position that blocks enemies from reaching your damage dealers. The revival is especially valuable around objectives, so avoid dying without a reason.
notes.sion-situational-thornmail: If an enemy physical damage dealer is sustaining through healing, build Thornmail earlier. Sion takes hits on the frontline, making it easy to keep applying Thornmail's reflected damage and healing reduction.
notes.sion-situational-spirit: If most enemy damage is magic, choose Spirit Visage as a defensive item. Spirit Visage amplifies W's shield and Sion's life steal during his revival.
notes.vs-sion-q: Forcing Sion to release Q early removes its knockup and stun. Move sideways out of Q while Sion charges it. If you cannot dodge Q, get close to Sion and force him to stop charging.
notes.vs-sion-r: Sion's R travels almost straight and has limited steering. Sidestep Sion's R. Choose a route that avoids meeting Sion's R in narrow passages or along walls. Sion's R deals less damage and stuns for less time when he travels a shorter distance. If you must block Sion's R, intercept him right after he starts charging.
notes.vs-sion-passive: After dying, Sion revives shortly afterward, attacks quickly, and deals damage based on maximum health. When Sion falls, reposition until his revival ends instead of continuing to fight there. Healing reduction is especially effective against Sion's increased life steal during his revival.
notes.vs-sion-w: Sion must wait a short time after activating W's shield before he can detonate it. Breaking W's shield first prevents the explosion. Focus damage on Sion right after he activates W to break the shield.
notes.vs-sion-scaling: Sion permanently gains maximum health each time he kills a unit. Even if you cannot kill Sion, push the lane to disrupt his farming. While Sion farms, gain an advantage in another lane. Do not ignore Sion and let the game drag on.
notes.sivir-combo-w-reset: Activating W resets your basic attack timer. Activate W right after a basic attack, then immediately attack again. Do not activate W early while waiting.
notes.sivir-combo-wave: To clear a wave, activate W, attack the front minions, then finish with Q. Q deals less damage with each non-champion target it hits in sequence. Q's sequential damage reduction resets on its return. Throw Q so both its outgoing and return paths overlap the minion wave.
notes.sivir-combo-r: After activating R, each basic attack against a champion reduces your basic abilities' cooldowns. A takedown resets R's duration.
notes.sivir-skill-q: Q returns to Sivir when it reaches maximum range. After throwing Q, move sideways to hit your opponent on its return path. In lane, do not waste the mana-heavy Q.
notes.sivir-skill-w: W-empowered attacks prioritize targets they have not hit yet. W-empowered attacks bounce to each target only a set number of times. Even if you hit the enemy front line with W, the damage reaches the back line. When you do not want to push the lane, do not attack minions with W active.
notes.sivir-skill-e: E is Sivir's only defensive tool. Use E to block roots or stuns rather than poke. Blocking an ability with E restores health and triggers the passive movement speed. Counterattack immediately after blocking an ability with E.
notes.sivir-skill-passive: Each time you damage an enemy champion, your passive movement speed increases sharply. Sivir has no dash, so she relies on her passive movement speed to dodge. Reposition with your passive movement speed right after landing Q or a basic attack.
notes.sivir-skill-r: R increases the movement speed of your entire team. Activate R when your team engages or retreats. Before using R, check that your teammates are grouped.
notes.sivir-phase: Q costs Sivir a lot of mana, making extended laning difficult. Sivir's wave clear is among the best. Learning R at level 6 lets you help your team engage and disengage. Sivir is strongest during midgame sieges once she has attack speed and critical strike. Sivir has no dash, making her weak in late-game duels.
notes.sivir-laning: Push the lane to keep your opponent under their turret and damage its plates. Save E to block the enemy jungler's engage ability.
notes.sivir-laning-e-bait: Activate E when the actual ability comes in, not when your opponent starts the engage animation. If you are unsure when to block with E, back away. Sivir is easy to kill if caught while E is down.
notes.sivir-teamfight: In teamfights, stay in the back line and hit the enemy front line with W. Hitting the front line with W lets the bouncing attacks reach the back line. Activate R when your team signals an engage or retreat. After activating R, keep attacking to reduce Q and W's cooldowns.
notes.sivir-objective: A Sivir composition wins through sieging. Clear waves quickly to keep your opponents under their turret. Use R to get your team onto the turret and push it down. If your opponents leave the turret, use R to retreat.
notes.sivir-situational-antiheal: If enemy healing is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after one core item. W's bounces can spread Grievous Wounds to multiple opponents.
notes.vs-sivir-e: Sivir's E blocks one entire ability. Feint an engage to draw out E, then apply guaranteed crowd control. Do not immediately use a targeted engage ability while Sivir's E is ready.
notes.vs-sivir-q: Sivir's Q costs a lot of mana, so dodging it puts her at a disadvantage. If Q hits you on the way out, anticipate its return path and step aside.
notes.vs-sivir-push: Sivir clears waves quickly and will damage your turret if left alone in lane. Before leaving lane, push the wave or have another teammate ready to catch it. Keep Sivir in lane and create a numbers advantage elsewhere.
notes.vs-sivir-mobility: Sivir has no teleporting mobility ability, only her passive movement speed. Prioritize diving Sivir when her E is down.
notes.vs-sivir-r: When Sivir activates R, her entire team speeds up. Do not chase or retreat slowly while Sivir's R is active. While Sivir's R is active, take only short fights that use terrain and vision. Wait for Sivir's R to end.
notes.skarner-combo-engage: Activate Q before engaging, use E to push the target into a wall and stun them, then land a Q-empowered basic attack. When your allies close in, pull the target with R. Activate Q in advance near a minion or jungle monster so you can land empowered basic attacks immediately after engaging.
notes.skarner-combo-r-turn: Targets suppressed by R are dragged in the direction Skarner moves. To pull a target farther into your team's position, turn around just before R ends.
notes.skarner-skill-passive: Basic attacks and Q, E, and R stack Quaking. At maximum stacks, it deals magic damage based on the target's maximum health. Stack Quaking on high health frontline champions too. Keep attacking a target within reach so their Quaking stacks do not expire.
notes.skarner-skill-q: Activating Q empowers your next basic attacks and increases attack speed. The final hit carries the maximum health damage and slow. Recasting Q gives up the remaining empowered hits to throw a rock and deal damage from range. If you are in range of the target, land all of Q's empowered basic attacks. If the target has already escaped basic attack range, recast Q to throw the rock.
notes.skarner-skill-w: W grants a shield based on Skarner's maximum health and slows nearby enemies in an area. Use W just before enemy damage lands or when you're already caught. Health items also increase W's shield.
notes.skarner-skill-e: E passes through terrain and drags a champion or large monster it hits until the charge ends. You must hit a wall with the target you drag using E to stun them. When engaging with E, line up your approach so a wall is behind the target. Hitting a target against a wall with E greatly reduces its cooldown.
