notes.xinzhao-skill-e: E is a targeted dash and cannot cross walls. To escape with E, you need a minion or jungle monster in the direction you want to flee. Before choosing where to fight, check whether there is a target behind you that you can dash to with E. Landing W makes the target Challenged, letting you engage from E's increased range.
notes.xinzhao-skill-r: R deals damage based on current health, knocks enemies back, and grants immunity to damage from outside your spear's range. The more of the enemy team's damage comes from marksmen and mages, the more valuable R's immunity becomes. Even with R active, you still take damage from nearby melee champions. Before engaging, check where the enemy team's main damage comes from to judge the value of R.
notes.xinzhao-skill-passive: Determination deals bonus damage and heals you on every third hit. W also counts toward Determination's hit count. During jungle clears and extended fights, use W consistently to benefit from Determination's healing. Determination's healing scales with maximum health, so health items also improve your sustain.
notes.xinzhao-phase: Your dueling and ganking become strong from level 3, when you have all three basic abilities. His kills at 14 minutes and damage per minute are below the jungler average, so he is not a champion who snowballs through early ganks alone. Clear camps while looking for skirmishes around objectives. In the late game, you can die easily once R ends, so avoid engaging alone.
notes.xinzhao-jungle-gank: If the enemy is pushed up in lane and an ally has crowd control, gank with E and Q. If the enemy has vision in the river, land W to make them Challenged, then engage from E's increased range.
notes.xinzhao-jungle-counter: His base movement speed and dueling strength make counterjungling valuable. When you confirm that the enemy jungler is clearing camps on the other side, take camps on the opposite side and leave. If you encounter the enemy jungler with your abilities ready, take the fight.
notes.xinzhao-teamfight-role: In teamfights, use R's knockback to clear space in front of your carries. Jump in just after an enemy diver reaches your carry and knock them away with R.
notes.xinzhao-teamfight-entry: Engage after the enemy has used their key crowd control. R's damage immunity applies only against champions outside your spear's range. Even with R active, you are vulnerable to nearby melee champions and crowd control. If an enemy melee diver is still alive, do not engage relying on R alone.
notes.xinzhao-situational-antiheal: A target who is healing may survive R's damage based on current health. If the target you need to kill is healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
notes.vs-xinzhao-q: Q's third empowered auto attack knocks the target airborne. If two Q-empowered auto attacks hit you, use a mobility ability or Flash to get out of range before the third. Much of Xin Zhao's damage and crowd control depends on Q's third hit.
notes.vs-xinzhao-r-immunity: When R is active, damage from champions outside his spear's range does not affect Xin Zhao. To deal damage during R, a marksman must move within his spear's range.
notes.vs-xinzhao-r-knockback: R knocks back only enemies who are not Challenged, splitting their formation. If you expect Xin Zhao to engage, space yourselves so the others can help even if one person is knocked back.
notes.vs-xinzhao-e: E is a targeted dash that cannot cross walls. Without a nearby minion or jungle monster, Xin Zhao cannot use E to chase or escape. To break Xin Zhao's pursuit, retreat across a wall into an empty area. When trying to kill Xin Zhao, force him into a position with no target behind him to dash to with E.
notes.vs-xinzhao-w: W is a slow skillshot, and its thrust deals most of its damage. Dodge W's thrust by moving sideways. Dodging W's thrust also avoids becoming Challenged and facing E's increased range.
notes.vs-xinzhao-r-window: Xin Zhao is very weak after R ends. When Xin Zhao engages, create distance to wait out R's immunity, then counterattack. In late-game teamfights, target Xin Zhao as soon as R ends.
notes.yasuo-combo-eq: Start a trade by using E through a minion to dash past your opponent. Use Q during your E dash. Q used during E hits in a circle around you, giving it a more forgiving hitbox than the forward thrust. Use Q during E, then follow up with a basic attack immediately after landing.
notes.yasuo-combo-tornado: After landing Q twice, your third Q becomes a tornado that knocks opponents airborne. Use R immediately after knocking your opponent airborne with your Q tornado. To save your tornado, hit minions with Q to maintain your stacks.
notes.yasuo-combo-e-chain: Chain E through different minions to close the gap on your opponent. When chasing, dash through minions and save E on your opponent. If you plan to retreat, use E directly on your opponent so you can use minions to escape.
notes.yasuo-combo-r-ally: R can also be used on enemies knocked airborne by allies.
notes.yasuo-skill-q: Q counts as a basic attack. Q can critically strike. Q applies life steal. Q applies on-hit effects. Increasing attack speed reduces Q's cooldown. Q has a narrow hitbox. Crowd control interrupts Q's cast. Predict when your opponent will move sideways and use Q.
notes.yasuo-skill-w: W only blocks projectiles. Turret attacks pass through W. Beam abilities pass through W. W cannot block projectiles that have already arrived before the wall forms. W has a long cooldown, so save it to block grab abilities or your opponent's key ranged abilities.
notes.yasuo-skill-e: E dashes through the selected target. You cannot use E again on the same target for a short time. Identify minions positioned to let you dash over walls with E in advance to secure an escape route. Before using E directly on an enemy champion, consider that you cannot use E on them again to close the gap for a while.
notes.yasuo-phase: Yasuo stacks Q slowly at levels 1–2 and tends to lose trades. Look for kill opportunities once you have invested skill points in Q and learned R at level 6. Prioritize surviving in the early game. Yasuo excels in the mid to late game with two or more critical strike items.
notes.yasuo-laning: Be careful not to push the wave carelessly with Q. Yasuo uses minions to approach or escape with E in lane. Only start a trade when you have two Q stacks and can use your tornado immediately. Start trading when your passive shield is available.
notes.yasuo-teamfight: Avoid being the one to initiate teamfights. Engage with R after allied crowd control or your own Q tornado knocks an enemy airborne. Before engaging with R, use minions and allies from the flank to set up an angle of approach. You gain armor penetration after using R. After using R, focus on killing the enemy backline.
notes.yasuo-situational-antiheal: If your opponent relies on healing to sustain, get Executioner's Calling for healing reduction. Yasuo tends to draw out duels. Yasuo struggles to secure kills in long duels if his opponent keeps healing.
notes.yasuo-situational-mercurial: If the enemy team initiates fights with crowd control that locks you down, buy Quicksilver Sash between core items. Yasuo loses damage while locked down because crowd control interrupts his Q.
notes.vs-yasuo-q-dodge: Yasuo's Q has a very narrow hitbox. When Yasuo approaches, move sideways instead of backing away to get out of Q's straight path.
notes.vs-yasuo-tornado: After Yasuo lands Q twice in a row, his next Q becomes a tornado that knocks opponents airborne. Watch and listen for the effects that signal full Q stacks so you can prepare to dodge the tornado.
notes.vs-yasuo-post-tornado: Yasuo's Q stacks reset when he fires his tornado. Treat the moment right after Yasuo fires his tornado as his weakest window in a fight. Start a fight right after Yasuo fires his tornado.
notes.vs-yasuo-shield: Yasuo's passive shield activates upon taking a single instance of damage. Yasuo's passive shield lasts briefly after activation. Use low-cost poke to strip Yasuo's passive shield first. Commit to a trade after Yasuo's passive shield disappears.
notes.vs-yasuo-wall: Yasuo's W only blocks projectiles. Turret attacks pass through Yasuo's W. Beam abilities pass through Yasuo's W. If you play a projectile-based champion, reposition to attack around Yasuo's W. If you play a projectile-based champion, hold your key abilities until Yasuo's W disappears.
notes.vs-yasuo-wave: Yasuo uses E through minions to close the gap. Keep a thin wave pushing toward your side to limit the minions Yasuo can use to approach with E.
notes.yasuo-skill-passive: The passive shield charges as you move. Keep moving in lane to charge your passive shield. When Flow is full, taking damage from a champion or monster triggers the passive shield, which lasts briefly. You're most vulnerable right after an enemy poke strips your passive shield.
notes.yone-skill-passive: His passive makes every second basic attack deal bonus magic damage. Yone gains greatly increased critical strike chance, but his critical strikes deal less damage. When poking, trade in sets of two basic attacks. Critical strike chance beyond the cap converts to attack damage.
notes.yone-skill-q-stack: Each Q hit grants a stack. At full stacks, the next Q becomes a dashing whirlwind that knocks enemies up. Q stacks disappear after a while. Hit a minion with Q just before a fight to prepare the whirlwind. Yone spends no resources to cast abilities.
notes.yone-skill-q-basic-attack: Q counts as a basic attack and can critically strike. The first target hit by Q receives on-hit effects and lifesteal. Crowd control interrupts Q's cast. If the opponent still has an immobilizing ability, do not engage with whirlwind Q first.
notes.yone-skill-w: W grants a larger shield for each champion it hits. Attack speed reduces W's cooldown and cast time. Early on, when attack speed is low, use W to block the opponent's key ability as it comes in.
notes.yone-skill-w-vs-tank: W deals physical and magic damage based on the target's maximum health. Count W as a damage option against high-health frontliners.
notes.yone-skill-e: Use E so you can return to your original position after engaging. Some of the damage dealt to champions in spirit form is dealt again when Yone returns to his body. Activate E before dealing damage so that damage counts toward the damage dealt on return. Yone cannot return to his body with E while under strong crowd control. Do not dive with E where the opponent still has an immobilizing ability ready.
notes.yone-skill-r: R moves Yone behind the last champion in its path. Avoid R angles that pass through every grouped enemy and leave you deep in their ranks. Before using R, check that it will pull enemies toward your team. If no champion is in R's path, Yone moves forward. Use R with no champion in its path to escape.
notes.yone-combo-trade: Stack Q on minions, knock the opponent up with whirlwind Q, then trade with two basic attacks, W, and one more basic attack. After knocking the opponent up with whirlwind Q, land the planned number of basic attacks and back off.
notes.yone-combo-allin: For an all-in, use E, whirlwind Q, a basic attack, W, R, a basic attack, then recast E. If you activate E late, damage dealt beforehand does not count toward its bonus damage on return. After activating E, deal enough damage before returning.
notes.yone-combo-r-followup: When following up on an ally's immobilization, use R to pull and knock the target up, then use whirlwind Q. As an enemy hit by R lands, knock them up again with whirlwind Q.
notes.yone-phase-early: Yone is weakest at levels 1–2, when his attack speed is low and he has no whirlwind Q. At levels 1–2, avoid forcing an engage; use Q to last-hit and manage your stacks.
notes.yone-phase-spike: Yone's power rises sharply as he gains attack speed and critical strike chance. Attack speed reduces W's cooldown and cast time. Start fighting proactively once you complete your first core item.
notes.yone-laning: Using Q repeatedly pushes the minion wave. When you do not know where the enemy jungler is, use Q less to farm, let the lane push toward you, and hold E. When the opponent has pushed the lane, close in with whirlwind Q and trade damage.
notes.yone-teamfight: In teamfights, only go deep into enemy ranks while E is active. Use W to hit several enemies and increase your shield. Save R if its angle would carry you through enemies and leave you too deep.
notes.yone-situational-mercurial: Buy Quicksilver Sash early if the enemy has many ways to lock Yone down. Yone cannot return to his body with E while under strong crowd control.
notes.yone-situational-antiheal: If the opponent's healing could turn a duel, buy Executioner's Calling between core items and upgrade it to Mortal Reminder. Yone can stay close and keep landing basic attacks to maintain Grievous Wounds.
notes.vs-yone-q-stack: Yone engages with whirlwind Q when its stacks are full. When Yone repeatedly hits minions with Q, his whirlwind becomes ready. When his whirlwind is ready, stay outside Yone's range until the stacks expire.
notes.vs-yone-cc: Yone cannot return to his body with E while under strong crowd control. Hold your immobilizing ability and use it when Yone enters in spirit form. Crowd control interrupts Yone's whirlwind Q.
notes.vs-yone-w-shield: Yone's W grants a larger shield the more champions it hits at once. In teamfights, spread out instead of lining up in Yone's approach path.
notes.vs-yone-r: Yone moves behind the last champion in R's path. Yone's R pulls in every enemy it hits.
notes.vs-yone-early: Yone is weakest early, before he gains attack speed. Pressure Yone at levels 1–2 to deny him health and CS.
notes.vs-yone-echo: Some of the damage Yone deals in spirit form is dealt again when he returns to his body. If Yone hits you in spirit form and you have about half your health left, heal or move out of his range before he returns.
notes.yorick-combo-basic: For a basic trade, mark the target with E, approach, then land a Q empowered attack and follow-up attacks. E's slow and movement speed boost let Yorick land a Q attack despite his short range. If E misses, do not close in on the enemy.
notes.yorick-combo-ghoul: After using the Q empowered attack, press Q again to raise Mist Walkers if enough graves are nearby. Pressing Q again opens nearby graves at once and raises Mist Walkers. Even if you save the Mist Walker summon, use the Q empowered attack when it comes off cooldown.
notes.yorick-combo-wall: When going for a kill, place W on the escape route first, then mark and slow the target with E before landing a Q attack. Allies can pass through the W wall, but it blocks enemies. Read where the enemy will retreat and place W behind them in advance. Placing W in front of the enemy makes it harder for Yorick to close in.
notes.yorick-skill-passive: Enemies dying near Yorick leave graves. Champions and large monsters always leave a grave when they die. Mist Walkers rise by consuming graves, and there is a limit to how many can be active at once. Before a fight, clear the wave near Yorick to set up graves.
notes.yorick-skill-q: The Q empowered attack deals damage and restores Yorick's health. Q's healing scales with missing health and is reduced against non-champions. Hit a champion with Q during trades to heal and secure a grave. Hitting a champion or large monster with Q leaves a grave there.
notes.yorick-skill-w: W creates terrain and deals no damage. The W wall has health, so attacks can destroy it, and movement abilities can cross it. W is strong for trapping enemies without movement abilities, but only buys a little time against enemies who still have a dash. If you suspect the enemy jungler is nearby, save W to cut off the jungler from the laner during a gank.
notes.yorick-skill-e: If an E-marked target is near graves, Mist Walkers keep rising and rushing at them. Yorick and his Mist Walkers gain movement speed when moving toward an E-marked target. E lowers the target's armor and slows them. Save E for gank follow-up or trades.
notes.yorick-skill-r: The Maiden of the Mist accounts for a large part of Yorick's fighting power. When Yorick hits a target marked by the Maiden's basic attack, he deals bonus damage based on the target's maximum health. In teamfights, attack the target the Maiden is attacking. After some time, press R again to send the Maiden down the nearest lane to pressure it. Send the Maiden when you want to draw one enemy to a side lane and gain a numbers advantage. If the enemy can cross the map quickly, keep the Maiden with you while fighting.
notes.yorick-laning: In lane, manage your health with Q's healing while securing CS. Instead of forcing kills, clear waves on Yorick's side of the lane to build up graves. If the enemy pushes the lane and roams, attack the turret.
notes.yorick-laning-trade: Yorick has virtually no movement abilities, so trade when the enemy steps forward. When the enemy steps forward for a last hit, slow them with E, then approach. Stand behind minions while E is on cooldown.
notes.yorick-phase: Yorick is weak at levels 1–2 because Q is his only trading tool. Once Yorick learns E, he can poke and approach, making his lane more stable. Getting the Maiden at level 6 strengthens Yorick's 1v1 and turret pressure. Yorick peaks in the mid to late game with items, when he can take down a side lane alone. Yorick has less impact in a standoff when all five enemies are grouped.
notes.yorick-teamfight: In teamfights, do not dive deep into the backline. Raise Mist Walkers just before a fight. Use W to block narrow passages, split the enemy formation, or protect your allies from behind. Engage after the enemy uses its crowd control on your allies. Hit a key enemy damage dealer with E so the Mist Walkers stick to them.
notes.yorick-situational-antiheal: If the enemy has a champion with strong healing, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item. Yorick can easily maintain Grievous Wounds by attacking continuously with basic attacks and Mist Walkers.
notes.yorick-situational-armor: If the enemy laner deals mostly physical damage, buy Cloth Armor early and get Plated Steelcaps sooner. Buy an item that helps you withstand poke before a damage item so you can stay in lane long enough to build up graves.
notes.vs-yorick-ghouls: A single basic attack or single-target ability kills a Mist Walker. Clear the Mist Walkers before fighting Yorick to reduce his damage. If you are a jungler with Smite, use it to clear Mist Walkers and the Maiden of the Mist.
notes.vs-yorick-graves: Each minion that dies near Yorick adds a grave that can become part of his army. Do not start a fight where many graves are set up. Keep pushing the lane so minions die under Yorick's turret.
notes.vs-yorick-wall: If trapped by W, attack and destroy the low-health wall before using a movement ability. If you have a dash or blink, cross the W wall. Yorick's W wall does not block his allies.
notes.vs-yorick-maiden: A target marked by the Maiden's basic attack takes bonus damage based on maximum health from Yorick's basic attacks. When the Maiden starts attacking you, create distance from Yorick first. Target Yorick himself while the Maiden is alone in a side lane.
notes.vs-yorick-split: If you have global mobility or can roam quickly, answer Yorick's side-lane push, then rejoin your team. If you can secure an objective elsewhere faster than Yorick can pressure a turret, that trade is not a loss.
notes.vs-yorick-e: Yorick has no movement ability, so he struggles to close in if E misses. Dodge the arc of E's mist projectile to avoid the trade. Step forward to farm while E is on cooldown.
notes.yunara-skill-passive-cycle: Stack Unleash with basic attacks, then activate Q. Basic attacks against champions build Unleash twice as fast. Fill your Unleash before a fight.
notes.yunara-skill-q: Q consumes Unleash to increase attack speed and make basic attacks splash to nearby targets. Q's splash attacks can crit and apply the passive's bonus magic damage. Time Q so you have Unleash left for the fight.
notes.yunara-skill-w: W heavily slows enemies and leaves an area that deals damage over time. After landing W, follow up before the slow ends. Place W's damage area in a low health enemy's escape path to finish them off. Early on, use W after the enemy is caught.
notes.yunara-skill-e: Base E grants ghosting and increased movement speed. E grants a larger movement speed boost when approaching an enemy champion. Use E's ghosting to move through minions. Yunara can dash only while transformed by R.
notes.yunara-skill-r: R changes the forms of her basic abilities. With R active, Q activates immediately without consuming Unleash and lasts longer. With R active, W becomes a piercing beam. With R active, E becomes a dash. Before activating R, decide whether to use it to attack or escape.
notes.yunara-combo-trade: Fill Unleash, activate Q, and land basic attacks. Use W if the enemy closes in or runs away. Use W to continue a trade that's already started.
notes.yunara-combo-ult: In a fight, use R to activate Q and land splash basic attacks, pierce grouped enemies with W, then adjust your angle with E. Activate Q just before R so you don't waste the discharge.
notes.yunara-phase-early: Yunara is weakest at levels 1–2. At levels 1–2, farm safely while building Unleash. Start trading from level 3, when Q's attack speed boost grows stronger.
notes.yunara-phase-late: Getting R at level 6 gives Yunara her first power spike. From level 6, use R's dash and piercing beam to start 2v2 fights. Late in the game, after building critical strike items, the passive's bonus magic damage also applies to Q's splash attacks, greatly increasing area damage.
notes.yunara-laning-wave: Activating Q makes splash attacks hit low health minions hard, pushing the wave. Activate Q to gain lane priority or set up a recall. Save Q when pulling the lane to set up a jungle gank, even if Unleash is full.
notes.yunara-laning-poke: One basic attack against an enemy champion builds as much Unleash as two against minions. Land one or two basic attacks on an enemy who comes into range, then back off to build Unleash. Don't use W on minions if the enemy still has an engage ability available.
notes.yunara-teamfight: In teamfights, stay behind your frontline and hit multiple enemies with Q's splash basic attacks. Save W to stop enemies diving your backline. Before a teamfight, decide whether to use R for area damage or to escape.
notes.yunara-situational-antiheal: If the enemy team's healing is a problem, reduce it with Mortal Reminder. Q's splash attacks also apply some on-hit effects, letting you apply healing reduction to multiple enemies.
notes.yunara-situational-cc: If the enemy team has a lot of immobilizing crowd control, buy Quicksilver Sash early. Without R, Yunara has trouble escaping when caught by immobilizing crowd control.
notes.vs-yunara-emanation: Yunara's damage rises sharply when her Unleash stacks are full. Trade with Yunara while she's building Unleash without Q active.
notes.vs-yunara-q-window: Spread out while Yunara's Q is active and wait out its duration. Engage Yunara right after her Q ends.
notes.vs-yunara-w: Yunara's W applies a strong slow, and its lingering damage finishes off low health enemies. If W hits you, leave its damage area immediately.
notes.vs-yunara-mobility: Without R, Yunara's E only grants movement speed and ghosting; it does not dash.
notes.vs-yunara-early: Yunara is weak at levels 1–2 because her Unleash is empty. At levels 1–2, push the lane and trade repeatedly to limit Yunara's chances to basic attack.
notes.yuumi-skill-w-attach: When Yuumi attaches to an ally with W, units other than turrets cannot target her. Yuumi's survival depends on staying attached. Keep her attachment from breaking when her ally dies or Yuumi is immobilized.
notes.yuumi-skill-w-switch: Recast W to switch attached allies at any time. If Yuumi is immobilized, she cannot reattach for a short time. When allies are spread out in a teamfight, check that the next ally is in range before attaching.
notes.yuumi-skill-w-danger: If the ally Yuumi is attached to dies, she drops at their location. If the attached ally's health gets dangerously low, switch to another ally before they die. When an ally dives in too far, decide first whether to go with them or attach to an ally who stayed back.
notes.yuumi-skill-passive: Yuumi's Best Friend is determined by friendship gained from takedowns while attached to an ally. While attached to her Best Friend, Q's slow is always empowered. Yuumi can steer R with her mouse only while attached to her Best Friend.
notes.yuumi-skill-q: Q must travel for a certain amount of time before its damage and slow are empowered. Start Q poke from as far away as possible so it becomes empowered. Yuumi can initially steer Q with her mouse after firing it while attached, but it locks into a straight path as it speeds up. Decide whether to steer Q right after firing it.
notes.yuumi-skill-e: E gives the attached ally a shield and attack speed. E also restores the attached ally's mana. The ally gains movement speed while E's shield lasts. Use E for chases and escapes as well as trades. Use E when an ally is low on mana to help them stay in lane.
notes.yuumi-skill-r: While channeling R, Yuumi can still move, switch attached allies, or use E. R's waves slow enemies and heal allies. Excess healing from R remains as a shield. Use R after both teams have grouped in one place.
notes.yuumi-combo-poke: Attach to an ally and land Q from long range, then follow up their attack by shielding them with E. While attached to her Best Friend, Q's empowered slow always applies. While attached to her Best Friend, their hit after Q deals bonus damage. Time Q's hit with your ally's follow-up attack.
notes.yuumi-phase: Yuumi is weak early and strong in the mid to late game once her allies have items. Yuumi has a hard time surviving if caught while unattached. In lane, aim to avoid losing rather than to win.
notes.yuumi-laning: Yuumi can use Q and E while attached. Detaching makes Yuumi a target for targeted abilities. Detach briefly only to establish vision or buy items. Leave all CS to the ADC. Leave decisions about lane priority to your ally.
notes.yuumi-vision: Yuumi cannot move on her own while attached, making solo roams and vision control virtually impossible. When your ally is in a safe position, detach briefly to place a Control Ward, then reattach immediately. Move with an ally into areas where vision is needed.
notes.yuumi-teamfight: Yuumi's impact in teamfights depends heavily on which ally she attaches to. Attaching to the frontline makes survival easier but makes it harder to reach allies who need help. Attaching to the backline exposes Yuumi to enemy dives alongside her ally. Once the enemy's engage tools are used, attach to the carry and focus E and R on them.
notes.yuumi-situational-mikael: If the enemy has immobilizing crowd control, build Mikael's Blessing before other support items to prevent it from breaking your attachment to an ally.
notes.vs-yuumi-target: While Yuumi is attached, nothing except turrets can target her.
notes.vs-yuumi-detach: Look for the moment Yuumi detaches to place a ward or reposition. Immobilizing Yuumi after she detaches prevents her from reattaching for a short time. Save targeted crowd control for the moment Yuumi detaches.
notes.vs-yuumi-laning: Yuumi cannot farm CS on her own and has weak lane pressure. During the laning phase, pressure bot lane with your jungler to build a lead. The later the game goes, the more favorable it becomes for Yuumi.
notes.vs-yuumi-r: R's waves repeatedly come from a set position. Watch R's position and move aside early to dodge its waves. Keep pressuring the ally Yuumi is attached to while dodging R's waves.
notes.zaahen-combo-q: After using Q, heal with two basic attacks, then recast Q and knock the enemy up with a basic attack. Q’s second knockup is applied by your next basic attack. Use Q’s knockup before the enemy leaves basic attack range.
notes.zaahen-combo-engage: Use E to dash past the enemy and hit them with its edge, pull them in with W, then land both stages of Q through basic attacks. Aim E beyond the enemy, rather than at a spot that overlaps them.
notes.zaahen-combo-r: Time R to the enemy’s burst ability or targeted ability cast. You take reduced damage while airborne during R. When you have little health left, using R makes the healing from its landing damage more valuable.
notes.zaahen-skill-passive-stack: Determination stacks build only when basic attacks or abilities hit enemy champions. In lane, build Determination stacks through short trades that briefly hit the enemy. At full Determination stacks, the attack damage increase from the stacks doubles.
notes.zaahen-skill-passive-revive: At full Determination, lethal damage briefly leaves you motionless before you revive with health. The revive cooldown is very long, leaving only a few chances to use it per game. Start objective fights and teamfights while your revive is ready. Play cautiously after using your revive.
notes.zaahen-skill-q: Q’s healing scales with maximum health and is halved against non-champions. Use Q healing from minions as a backup when needed. Use Q’s bonus damage to monsters to clear jungle camps and objectives.
notes.zaahen-skill-w: W pulls enemies hit in a straight line toward Zaahen. Position yourself where you want to pull the enemy before using W. Position with allied crowd control or a turret behind you, then use W to pull the enemy into it.
notes.zaahen-skill-e: E is Zaahen’s only mobility ability and his biggest source of damage. Only enemies hit by the edge of E’s cleave take increased physical damage and magic damage based on their maximum health. Keep E available to escape when a gank is possible.
notes.zaahen-skill-r-passive: Learning R increases armor penetration. Trades against enemies building armor become stronger after you learn R.
notes.zaahen-laning: Zaahen can hold his own in early trades, but his CS and kill stats are low among top champions. In lane, build Determination stacks through short trades while pressuring the turret. Do not spend all your abilities farming; save mana for trades.
notes.zaahen-laning-trade: Clip the enemy with E’s edge, land both stages of Q through basic attacks, then back off. Save W for when the enemy flees or needs to be pulled under the turret.
notes.zaahen-phase: Zaahen can hold his own in trades from levels 1–2. Zaahen’s power spikes sharply when full Determination stacks coincide with reaching level 6 and learning R. Judge Zaahen’s power windows by Determination stacks and the revive cooldown more than by level.
notes.zaahen-teamfight: Zaahen takes the frontline role in teamfights. At full Determination, engage first with E and pull a backline enemy toward your team with W. If the revive is on cooldown, follow after your allies engage.
notes.zaahen-situational-antiheal: If the enemy team relies on its own healing to survive, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items. Zaahen stays on enemies and deals damage over time, so he can maintain Grievous Wounds for a long time.
notes.vs-zaahen-stacks: Zaahen builds Determination stacks and gains attack damage by hitting enemy champions. Keep trades short and avoid even glancing hits from Zaahen. Do not duel Zaahen at full Determination stacks.
notes.vs-zaahen-revive: At full Determination, Zaahen revives with health shortly after dying. Force Zaahen to use his revive before starting objective fights or teamfights.
notes.vs-zaahen-e: Getting hit by the edge of E’s cleave deals heavy damage and magic damage based on your maximum health. Move toward the end of Zaahen’s dash to stand inside E’s edge.
notes.vs-zaahen-qw: Zaahen’s Q knockup is applied by his next basic attack. When Zaahen prepares the knockup, move out of basic attack range. Avoid standing in a straight line between Zaahen and his allies so W cannot pull you toward them.
notes.vs-zaahen-r: While airborne during R, Zaahen takes reduced damage and heals for part of the landing damage. Save burst abilities for Zaahen until R lands. Move away from R’s landing area to reduce Zaahen’s healing. Zaahen is vulnerable to Grievous Wounds.
notes.zac-combo-engage: Land E on the enemy backline to knock them up, then use R immediately. Chain E into R to scatter the enemy formation and give your team a favorable position to start the teamfight.
notes.zac-combo-r-w: You can use W while bouncing with R. After activating R, keep using W between bounces to deal more damage. During R, you become ghosted and can move through enemies. Aim your R bounces toward the enemy backline.
notes.zac-combo-q-sling: After Q grabs the first enemy, your follow-up basic attack gains range. Basic attack a different enemy while holding one with Q to throw them into each other and knock them up. You need at least two enemies to collide them with Q. If there is only one enemy, use Q to slow them and do not hold back your basic attacks.
notes.zac-combo-q-escape: Casting Q does not stop Zac from moving. When disengaging, throw Q behind you to slow pursuers.
notes.zac-skill-e-charge: The longer you charge E, the farther you fly. Moving while charging E cancels the cast and refunds half its cooldown and cost. If the enemy notices you charging E and backs away, cancel the cast to reduce the loss. Silences, roots, stuns, and knockups interrupt E's charge.
notes.zac-skill-e-range: E can fly in from far away and gank while barely passing through warded areas. For a gank, first choose a spot behind a wall and out of vision to charge E.
notes.zac-skill-w: W has a short cooldown and deals damage based on the target's maximum health. In teamfights, use W whenever it is ready, even against the frontline. W's health-based damage is capped against minions and jungle monsters. When clearing the jungle, do not rely on W as your main clearing tool.
notes.zac-skill-passive-blob: Hitting an enemy with an ability drops a blob. Picking it up restores health and reduces W's cooldown. During fights, path over your blobs to pick them up. Enemy champions can destroy blobs by stepping on them, so collect them before it is too late.
notes.zac-skill-passive-revive: Zac's revive passive has a very long cooldown. Attempt dives or risky engages when the revive passive is ready. When the revive passive is on cooldown, play like a regular frontline champion. Use the revive passive in close fights, but do not count on it in fights you are certain to lose.
notes.zac-phase: Zac has relatively low kill pressure and damage early on. Early on, clear camps safely and keep up in levels. After level 6, with E and R available, you can force fights over objectives. Once you have built up items, W damage and healing from blobs give you strong staying power in teamfights.
notes.zac-laning-gank: When ganking, choose a spot behind a wall and out of enemy vision to charge E. Fire E after your laner draws the enemy forward by trading damage.
notes.zac-teamfight-target: When engaging with E, land toward the enemy backline. If you land on the enemy frontline, Zac has very little he can do. After landing, look for an angle to throw an enemy damage dealer toward your team with Q.
notes.zac-teamfight-role: If the enemy ignores Zac, W damage keeps adding up. If the enemy attacks Zac, your team's damage dealers are free to act. After engaging, stay alive by picking up blobs.
notes.zac-situational-mr: If the enemy has strong magic damage, build Spirit Visage early. Spirit Visage increases both magic resistance and healing from blobs.
notes.vs-zac-e-interrupt: Zac's E charging animation is visible. If Zac charges E behind a wall, interrupt it with a silence, root, stun, or knockup.
notes.vs-zac-blob: Enemy champions can destroy Zac's blobs by stepping on them. Step on blobs during fights to prevent Zac from healing and reducing W's cooldown. Use immobilizing crowd control to keep Zac from collecting blobs.
notes.vs-zac-revive: Zac's revive passive has a very long cooldown. Before committing to a 1v1 or an objective fight, check whether Zac's revive passive is ready.
notes.vs-zac-revive-deny: Ignite and Smite can hit the pieces Zac splits into after going down. If you have area damage, wait until the revival pieces are close together, then clear them all at once.
notes.vs-zac-kite: Zac needs to stay close to enemies to deal most of his damage. After weathering Zac’s engage, create distance as you fight to avoid his W damage.
notes.zed-combo-basic: Place your W shadow behind or beside the enemy. Use W → Q → E for a basic trade. Hitting the same target with the same ability from both Zed and his shadow restores energy.
notes.zed-combo-ult: Make sure you have enough energy before an R combo. Start your R combo with all abilities off cooldown. In an R combo, use Q and E so both Zed and his shadow hit the target. The R mark's detonation damage scales with the damage Zed deals while the mark is active.
notes.zed-combo-w-safe: Before using R, place your W shadow in a safe spot behind you. Return to your pre-placed W shadow immediately after the R mark detonates. Use W and R shadows together to secure entry and escape routes.
notes.zed-skill-w-double: Quickly press W twice to immediately move to where the shadow lands. Practice quickly pressing W twice for emergency escapes.
notes.zed-skill-w-cost: Treat the moment just after Zed uses W as his weakest window. Zed relies on his shadows for damage, slows, and movement. Avoid wasting W on poke when the enemy jungler is missing.
notes.zed-skill-e-slow: E's slow only applies when a shadow lands the hit.
notes.zed-skill-q: Using Q makes both Zed and his shadows throw shurikens. Q shurikens pass through targets. Q shurikens deal reduced damage to enemies beyond the first target. Make the enemy champion the first target hit by Q.
notes.zed-skill-passive: P adds damage based on the target's maximum health when you basic attack an enemy below half health. P cannot trigger again on the same champion for a while. Use at least one basic attack during the combo. Avoid staying in a fight just to trigger P again on the same champion.
notes.zed-phase: Zed is strong at trading at levels 1–2. Zed can start looking for solo kills after learning R at level 6. Zed peaks in the mid game with a couple of items. Zed's strength drops sharply in the late game as enemies build armor and group up. Build a game-ending lead during your mid-game peak.
notes.zed-laning: Zed relies heavily on energy management in lane. Hitting the same target with the same ability from both Zed and his shadow restores energy. Place the shadow before poking in lane. Avoid spending Q solely on clearing minions so you have energy left for trades and escapes.
notes.zed-teamfight: Avoid engaging head-on in teamfights. Flank from the side or rear and focus on one enemy damage dealer. Use R after the enemy has spent their protective abilities and crowd control on your allies. Aim to survive until the R mark detonates. Always keep a spot available to return to with W.
notes.zed-situational-antiheal: If enemy healing prevents you from killing them in one combo, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
notes.zed-situational-mr: Choose Maw of Malmortius if the enemy's main damage is magic damage.
notes.vs-zed-w: Treat the moment just after Zed uses W as his most vulnerable window. Zed relies on his shadows for damage, slows, and movement. Approach after the W shadow disappears or Zed has already swapped positions.
notes.vs-zed-e: E's slow only applies when a shadow lands the hit. To avoid the slow, check the shadow's position and move outside its E range.
notes.vs-zed-r-track: After engaging with R, Zed must stick to his target and build up damage before the mark detonates. Use crowd control on Zed while the R mark is active to interrupt his combo and reduce the detonation damage.
notes.vs-zed-late: Zed peaks in the mid game. Zed gets weaker as the game goes later. Avoid giving Zed an early lead. Move together with your allies to prevent Zed from killing isolated targets.
notes.zed-skill-e-cdr: Each enemy champion hit by Zed's own E reduces W's cooldown by 3 seconds. An E used by a shadow does not reduce W's cooldown. To use W again during a fight, use E from a position where Zed himself can hit multiple enemies.
notes.zeri-skill-q: Zeri's real basic attack is Q. Q counts as a basic attack and can critically strike. As attack speed increases, Q's cast time and cooldown decrease. Attack speed above the cap is converted into attack damage.
notes.zeri-skill-w-wall: W spreads into a long laser when it hits terrain. A W that spreads after hitting terrain critically strikes champions and monsters. Aim W at opponents with a wall behind them or at the walls of narrow passages.
notes.zeri-skill-w-slow: W is Zeri's only slow. If an enemy engage champion is still alive, decide whether you'll need W's slow before using it to poke.
notes.zeri-skill-e: E travels much farther when crossing terrain. Use E to cross a wall when escaping. Basic attack hits and critical strikes reduce E's cooldown. Keep attacking during fights to get your next E sooner.
notes.zeri-skill-e-pierce: After using E, your next Q pierces enemies. Against an opponent behind minions or several enemies lined up, use E before attacking with Q.
notes.zeri-skill-passive: Moving or using Q charges your passive. A fully charged basic attack deals magic damage based on the target's maximum health. Keep moving in lane to charge your passive. A fully charged basic attack deals especially high damage to high-health opponents.
notes.zeri-skill-r: After activating R, each hit on an enemy champion adds a stack and increases your movement speed. After activating R, each hit on an enemy champion extends its duration. Activating R turns Q into rapid fire with chain lightning. Activate R when you can keep attacking, rather than when the fight will end after one takedown.
notes.zeri-combo-allin: When engaging, slow with W, approach with E, then fire Q repeatedly and activate R. When disengaging, gain movement speed with R, then cross a wall with E. Crossing a wall with E while R is active lets you shake off most pursuers.
notes.zeri-phase: In lane, use W that hits a wall and charged basic attacks to hold your ground while farming CS. Zeri is strong at farming during the laning phase. She becomes much stronger once she has two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike chance.
notes.zeri-laning: Zeri's basic attack range is short even among marksmen. Avoid standing too far forward in lane. Move to avoid enemy poke while charging your passive and farming. Clear waves with Q. Fire W only from positions where you can angle it into a wall.
notes.zeri-teamfight: In teamfights, keep landing Q from the side. In teamfights, position beside a wall that gives you both an angle for W to spread and an escape route with E. E and R's mobility make it easier to evade enemies who engage on you. Position with the risk of dying if caught in mind.
notes.zeri-situational-antiheal: If the enemy has healing, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Zeri wears enemies down with sustained damage, making her vulnerable to their healing.
notes.zeri-situational-qss: If the enemy starts fights with targeted crowd control, buy Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar between core items. Zeri deals sustained damage while moving with E and R, so being locked down takes away her strengths.
notes.vs-zeri-range: Zeri's basic attack range is short even among marksmen. If you play a long-range champion, build a lead by poking Zeri before she gets her core items.
notes.vs-zeri-w: Zeri's W spreads when it hits terrain, greatly increasing its damage. When facing Zeri, don't stand with your back to a wall. Don't face Zeri head-on in a narrow passage. In open terrain, Zeri's W stops at the first target it hits.
notes.vs-zeri-e: Zeri's E travels much farther when crossing terrain. When trying to catch Zeri, force her into open terrain away from walls.
notes.vs-zeri-r: Zeri gains movement speed as she hits enemies while R is active. If Zeri activates R, give up chasing her on foot or stop her immediately with an immobilizing effect. When Zeri's R is down, E is her only mobility tool.
notes.vs-zeri-squishy: Zeri has little kill pressure during the laning phase. Catch Zeri before she completes her core items. Once she has her core items, Zeri's mobility makes her harder to pick off.
notes.ziggs-combo-basic: Place E under the enemy or on their escape route, then throw Q when they’re slowed. E’s slow makes the delayed Q easier to land.
notes.ziggs-combo-satchel: Place W behind the enemy and detonate it to knock them toward Ziggs. Place W, throw Q, then knock the enemy into Q’s landing spot. Place W between Ziggs and the enemy and detonate it to retreat.
notes.ziggs-combo-passive-turret: The passive’s empowered basic attack deals more damage to structures. Using an ability reduces the passive’s cooldown. At a turret, clear waves with abilities to bring up the passive sooner, then use the empowered basic attack on the turret. Save W for when the turret’s health falls below its demolition threshold.
notes.ziggs-skill-q: Q is your main poke and wave clear tool, and has the shortest cooldown. Keep using Q as long as you have the mana. Aim Q where the enemy is going, not where they’re standing. Throw Q when the enemy stops to last-hit behind minions or use an ability.
notes.ziggs-skill-w: W is Ziggs’s only mobility tool. When chasing or escaping, detonate W beneath you to cross a wall. If you need W to escape, don’t use it to poke. If you see a chance to push a turret, save W to demolish it as soon as its health is low enough.
notes.ziggs-skill-e: Use E to block the enemy’s path. If the same target steps on multiple mines in succession, subsequent damage is greatly reduced. Place E in narrow passages, at brush entrances, and on approach routes leading behind your allies. When retreating, place E beneath you to stop the enemy from engaging.
notes.ziggs-skill-r: R’s long range lets it reach fights in other lanes and near objectives. Hit with the center of R’s explosion to deal its full damage. Aim R at grouped enemies or narrow terrain where they’ll struggle to escape. When supporting another lane with R, wait until an ally pins the enemy down. If there’s no chance to support from range, use R to clear waves or pressure a turret.
notes.ziggs-laning: In bot lane, use Q’s range instead of trading basic attacks. Keep poking with Q from outside the enemy marksman’s basic attack range. If the enemy moves forward, block their escape route with E. If the enemy support has an engage ability, stand behind your support.
notes.ziggs-laning-wave: You can clear a group of minions with one Q to push the lane when you want. Push the wave to the enemy turret and attack it with the passive’s empowered basic attack. Before pushing the lane, check that W is available and you have vision.
notes.ziggs-teamfight: Start teamfights behind your allies; don’t move forward to look for an angle. Place E on the enemy’s approach route before the fight starts. Once the fight starts, use Q repeatedly. During the fight, aim R at grouped enemies.
notes.ziggs-phase: At levels 1–2, Q’s long cooldown and limited mana make it slow to poke repeatedly. Lane pressure grows stronger as you put more ranks into Q and get a mana item. Learning R at level 6 lets you influence other lanes. Late game, when you’ve built up ability power, is Ziggs’s strongest phase. In late game, stand farther back because Ziggs is fragile.
notes.ziggs-situational-zhonya: If the enemy has an assassin who dives in, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier. Ziggs has no mobility tool besides W, so it’s hard for him to escape on foot if an enemy catches him.
notes.ziggs-situational-antiheal: If the enemy has a champion with strong healing, buy Morellonomicon after completing your first core item. Ziggs can land abilities often to apply healing reduction over a wide area.
notes.vs-ziggs-e: Go around the path covered by E, or wait for the mines to disappear. If E slows you, Ziggs’s other abilities become easier to land on you. Before engaging on Ziggs, identify an approach that E doesn’t cover.
notes.vs-ziggs-cooldown: Look for an opening right after Ziggs uses a full rotation of abilities. Engage right after Ziggs uses W to poke or clear a wave. Without W, Ziggs has a hard time escaping on foot.
notes.vs-ziggs-r: The center of R’s explosion deals the most damage; the edge deals much less. When R’s warning area appears, move away from the center even if you can’t escape it entirely. Near an objective, don’t group in one spot even if Ziggs isn’t visible.
notes.vs-ziggs-mobility: Ziggs has very low movement speed, and W is his only mobility tool. Engage when Ziggs has used W or is somewhere he can’t cross a wall. If Ziggs still has W, check vision and your chase route on the other side of the wall before engaging.
notes.vs-ziggs-turret: Ziggs’s W instantly demolishes turrets below a certain health threshold. Turrets don’t recover health on their own. If a turret has lost a lot of health, keep clearing waves in that lane so Ziggs can’t demolish it with W.
notes.zilean-combo-doublebomb: Use Q → W → Q to stun with the bombs. Placing a second bomb on a target carrying one makes the first explode immediately, stunning nearby enemies. W reduces Q's cooldown so you can cast Q again right away. Start the bomb combo when the enemy is standing still or held in place. If the enemy leaves the bomb radius between casts, the combo will deal no damage or stun them.
notes.zilean-combo-engage: Slow an enemy with E, then stun them with Q → W → Q. E's strong slow makes it hard for the enemy to walk out of the bomb radius. To help an ally engage, speed them up with E before using the bomb combo. Before casting E, decide whether to slow an enemy or speed up an ally.
notes.zilean-skill-q-attach: Q lands at the chosen spot and attaches to the first unit that comes close. Q prioritizes champions and units already carrying a bomb. If the enemy champion is outside the bomb radius, a minion may pick it up first. Throw Q where the enemy is about to walk, rather than where they are now.
notes.zilean-skill-w: W deals no damage on its own. W reduces E's cooldown as well as Q's. When escaping, speed yourself up with E and use W to get E back. If the fight may drag on, save one W for a second stun or another E.
notes.zilean-skill-e: E greatly slows one enemy or speeds up one ally. Use E on an enemy engager as they jump onto an ally. Use E on an ally when they try to finish off an enemy. When the enemy jungler is missing, keep E available for survival.
notes.zilean-skill-r-timing: For R's revive to trigger, the targeted ally must die while it is active. If you cast R too early, the enemy may switch to another ally. If you cast R too late, the ally may die before you can cast it. Cast R after you see a key targeted enemy ability hit an ally. An ally is untargetable while reviving with R. Time your counterattack around the ally's revival.
notes.zilean-skill-r-bluff: R on an ally can make enemies hesitate to attack them. You can cast R on your main damage dealer early to deter an engage near an objective or in a narrow passage. R has a long cooldown, so don't waste it before the next fight.
notes.zilean-skill-passive: You can give an ally the experience stored by P to level them up. When P gives an ally experience, Zilean gains the same amount. Use P when it will change an ally's level. Use P when an ally can get their level 6 ultimate early or level up just before a fight. During lane phase, use P on a bot lane ally. From mid game onward, use P on the ally initiating fights at that point.
notes.zilean-laning-poke: Throw a bomb ahead of time as the enemy steps forward to last-hit. If the enemy stands behind minions, throw a bomb at their position ahead of time. If the enemy dodges the bomb, it may attach to a minion and push the wave. Q costs a lot of mana, so casting it carelessly will drain your mana quickly. Throw Q when the enemy will have trouble leaving the bomb's landing spot. Stand behind or beside your allied marksman when throwing bombs.
notes.zilean-laning-wave: If a bomb attaches to a minion, it pushes the wave. Save Q when your ally wants to keep the wave near your side. When pushing toward the enemy turret to roam, use bombs to push the wave. Right after pushing the wave, speed up an ally with E and head to mid or the jungle.
notes.zilean-phase: Levels 1–2 are Zilean's weakest point because he has no W to set up a bomb stun. Start trading at level 3, when learning W lets you use Q → W → Q. After learning R at level 6, Zilean becomes stronger in fights because he can save an ally. Zilean's own damage becomes relatively low in the late game. In the late game, focus on protecting allies with R and E rather than poking.
notes.zilean-teamfight: In teamfights, stay back and protect your allies. If an enemy dives your backline, slow them with E and stun them with Q → W → Q. Cast R just before your main damage dealer comes under focused attack. A bomb stun can hit multiple enemies within its radius. Look for a bomb stun when enemies group up in a narrow passage.
notes.zilean-situational-mikael: If the enemy has a lot of crowd control that can lock down your main damage dealer, build Mikael's Blessing between core items. Mikael's Blessing frees an ally when they are caught, while R triggers after its target dies.
notes.zilean-situational-antiheal: Build Morellonomicon if enemy healing is strong enough to turn a fight. Area bombs can apply healing reduction to multiple enemies at once.
notes.vs-zilean-bomb: Zilean must attach two bombs to the same target to stun them. If the first bomb attaches to you, move away from your allies and out of its explosion radius. Standing next to an ally carrying a bomb can get you caught in its stun too.
notes.vs-zilean-r: An ally with R revives where they die. The target cannot be targeted while reviving with R. If you can keep pace with Zilean, finish off the target after R expires. If you cannot wait for R to expire, prepare to attack the target again right after they revive.
notes.vs-zilean-e: E slows or speeds up only one person at a time. When engaging, approach from multiple directions so one E cannot stop everyone. Engaging alone makes it easy for E to slow you and leave you open to the bomb combo.
notes.vs-zilean-early: At levels 1–2, Zilean has no W and cannot set up a bomb stun. At levels 1–2, get close to Zilean and pressure him. From level 3, Zilean can use the Q → W → Q combo. If you gained no early advantage, farm outside bomb range after level 3.
notes.vs-zilean-target: Zilean himself has no mobility ability. If R makes your allied damage dealer hard to kill, switch your target to Zilean. If you kill Zilean first, his team loses his protection and speed boosts.
notes.zoe-combo-core: After landing E, time Q to hit when the target falls asleep, then follow with an empowered basic attack and W missiles. Time Q to arrive as the first damage when the target falls asleep. The first damage dealt to a sleeping target is doubled. Don't let a basic attack or W missile hit before Q.
notes.zoe-combo-q: You can redirect Q once after firing it. Q's damage increases with the total distance the star travels. Send Q far to the side or behind you, then redirect it toward the target. Fire Q from a safe spot where you won't be interrupted between casting and redirecting it.
notes.zoe-combo-re: Throw E first and let the bubble grow, then use R to follow it. Use R to briefly cross a wall and throw E, then return to your starting point. When combining skills with R, always account for where you'll return.
notes.zoe-skill-passive: Your first basic attack after using an ability is empowered by your passive. Early on, use empowered passive attacks to poke or finish off targets; don't waste them on minion last hits. Both casting and recasting Q trigger your passive.
notes.zoe-skill-e-wall: Throwing E over a wall extends its range. Hide in a bush or behind a wall and throw E from an angle the enemy can't see. If E hits no one, the bubble remains where it lands as a trap. Place E traps ahead of time in front of the first turret or at dragon and Herald entrances to block the path.
notes.zoe-skill-e-timing: A target hit by E falls asleep after a short delay. Land E while the target is held in place. Follow up allied crowd control with E. Throw E through narrow passages. Hitting a champion with E greatly reduces Zoe's ability cooldowns.
notes.zoe-skill-w-shard: W shards drop from enemy summoner spells, active items, and certain minions. Keep track of the enemy's used spells and tell your team. Pick up W shards that drop in lane. In teamfights, use defensive or utility shards that can save allies.
notes.zoe-skill-w-move: Using W or a summoner spell increases your movement speed. W missiles fly toward the target you last hit with a basic attack. Use W shards when you need movement speed, such as to find an angle to engage or escape a gank.
notes.zoe-skill-r: After moving briefly with R, Zoe always returns to her original position. While displaced by R, Zoe can use abilities and basic attacks, but she can't walk. Use R to extend your ability range or gain vision over a wall. After a delayed targeted dash is cast, use R to stay briefly beyond a wall and leave the enemy there.
notes.zoe-laning: In lane, use Q to last-hit and poke while looking for an angle to land E. Use your abilities when the enemy steps forward. Spamming Q leaves you short on mana and makes farming difficult. Use Q from a position where it can hit multiple targets.
notes.zoe-roam: After clearing the wave, move behind a river or jungle wall to find an angle for E.
notes.zoe-phase: At levels 1–2, E has a long cooldown and mana is scarce, so mistakes are costly. Once you've learned E and completed one item, landing E enables a combo that can kill one enemy. Zoe's burst remains strong in the late game. In the late game, once enemies have their engage abilities available, first position yourself where you can survive.
notes.zoe-teamfight: Start teamfights from the very back. Follow up an ally's immobilizing crowd control with E or Q. Move forward after confirming the enemy has used their engage abilities. While the enemy still has engage abilities, hold your position with E traps and movement speed from W shards.
notes.zoe-situational-zhonya: If the enemy has an assassin who can engage instantly, get Zhonya's Hourglass early, since you can't escape with R.
notes.vs-zoe-q: Zoe has very little time to redirect Q. Stun or root Zoe as she fires Q and lines up its angle.
notes.vs-zoe-r: Zoe always returns to her starting point after using R. When Zoe uses R, aim at her starting point to counterattack. Zoe can't walk while displaced by R.
notes.vs-zoe-e: Even if E's bubble hits you, sleep takes effect after a short delay. After E hits you, move behind a wall or an ally so you fall asleep outside Zoe's Q angle. If you have Cleanse or Quicksilver Sash, use it to remove E's sleep.
notes.vs-zoe-trap: A missed E bubble remains where it lands as a trap. Move carefully through narrow paths without vision, bush entrances, and areas in front of objectives. Before starting an objective, use a Control Ward to reveal the surrounding area.
notes.vs-zoe-w: Using a summoner spell or active item near Zoe drops a shard she can reuse. If Zoe is in sight, save spells you don't urgently need. Right after using Flash near Zoe, move as though she can use that Flash to follow you.
notes.vs-zoe-dive: Against Zoe, aim to get within range and stick to her. If you have an engage ability, go in right after Zoe uses E.
notes.zyra-combo-basic: Place a W seed where E roots the target, then use Q. If both E and Q hit one seed, both types of plants grow. Start with E because using Q first lets the target walk away and avoid the plant damage.
notes.zyra-combo-seed-after: Use Q or E first, then throw a W seed into the skill's path. W has virtually no cast time, so you can place a seed while Q or E is traveling. Place seeds in advance only when you are sure where the target will move.
notes.zyra-combo-ult: Place a seed, grow plants with Q and E, then cast R over them. Plants inside R become enraged, have their duration refreshed, and deal more damage. Save E until R knocks the target up, then root them right after they land.
notes.zyra-skill-passive: P seeds spawn faster as you level up. P seeds stop spawning while you are hidden in a brush. When waiting in a brush, plant seeds before entering it. If an enemy champion steps on a seed, it disappears and briefly reveals their location.
notes.zyra-skill-w: W stores charges, and killing minions or monsters speeds up its recharge. Before a fight, keep at least one W charge for your combo. If W is fully charged, plant seeds along paths to use for vision.
notes.zyra-skill-q: Use plants grown by Q to clear waves and pressure towers. Q has a delayed detonation, so it often misses moving targets. When targeting a champion, time Q with a root or an ally's crowd control. If you spend mana to push the lane, gain an advantage by setting up vision or roaming.
notes.zyra-skill-e: E is Zyra's only guaranteed crowd control and the start of her combo. Do not waste E on wave clear. Vine Lashers grown from seeds in E's path are short range melee plants. If the enemy only pokes from afar, use your seeds with Q.
notes.zyra-skill-r: R has a delay between its cast and knockup, so targets with mobility skills can leave its area. To land R's knockup, cast it on enemies immobilized by an ally or in a narrow passage. Cast R ahead of an advancing enemy to block their path.
notes.zyra-laning: When the enemy support steps forward to protect their ADC or place a ward, root them with E and add a seed. If Zyra misses E, she has few ways to withstand a counterattack. When E is on cooldown, fall back and build up seeds.
notes.zyra-laning-brush: Zyra is strong at ambushing enemies in areas where she has prepared seeds. Place seeds near a brush by a passage, then lead with E when the enemy enters.
notes.zyra-teamfight: Start teamfights behind your allies at the edge of your range. Before a fight, scatter seeds where your allies will stand and along the enemy's approach. As the enemy engages, cut off their path with E and R.
notes.zyra-phase: Zyra is weakest at levels 1–2, when seeds spawn slowly and she has few skills. From level 3, after learning E and Q and building up seeds, Zyra can trade damage. Zyra's power peaks at level 6 when she learns R and in the mid game when she gains ability power.
notes.zyra-situational-antiheal: If the enemy has strong healing, finish one core item, then use Morellonomicon to reduce healing. Zyra lands many hits, including with her plants, making it easy to apply healing reduction.
notes.zyra-situational-zhonya: If the enemy has an assassin who dives in, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier. Zyra has no mobility skill, so she has no way out once caught.
notes.vs-zyra-seed: Zyra's seeds disappear when stepped on. If you see a Zyra seed along your path, step on it to remove it.
notes.vs-zyra-plants: Fully grown plants can be removed with attacks and disappear on their own over time. In an area full of plants, back off briefly and wait for them to disappear. Zyra is weakest when there are no plants nearby.
notes.vs-zyra-position: Leave the area where Zyra has been set up for a while and fight around another objective in fresh terrain. If Zyra places her plants far from herself, move in on Zyra.
notes.vs-zyra-e: Zyra relies heavily on her E root in fights. E travels in a straight line. At the edge of its range, move sideways to bait out E, then engage while it is on cooldown.
notes.vs-zyra-r: R knocks enemies up when its summoned vines contract after a delay. When you see R's cast indicator, leave its area immediately and use a mobility skill then if you have one. Avoid fighting near groups of plants so Zyra has a harder time enraging them with R.
notes.vs-zyra-vision: Zyra's seeds give her team vision. Assume Zyra's team has vision in areas where she has stayed for a while, and plan your approach accordingly. Check a brush where you suspect an ambush with a control ward or a skill before entering.
